preview: I express gratitude and love for Jesus Christ and His Atonement, for His willingness to leave the realms of the heavens as a God and come to earth as a lowly babe.

title: His Peace
preview: Just as Jesus’ anxious Apostles were given peace by “another Comforter,” so today can all men and women receive the same marvelous blessing each day of their lives.

title: “In His Strength I Can Do All Things”
preview: Ordinary men, blessed with the privilege of holding the priesthood of God, may be called upon to do extraordinary tasks and accomplish mighty feats through faith in that sacred power!

title: Jesus Christ, Our Redeemer
preview: The Redeemer loves you and will help you do the essential things that bring happiness now and forever.

title: Keep Walking, and Give Time a Chance
preview: Virginia H. Pearce delivers a message titled "Keep Walking, and Give Time a Chance."

title: May We Be Faithful and True
preview: The Lord is watching over His kingdom. He is inspiring its leadership to care for its ever-growing membership.

title: Modern Pioneers
preview: Janette Hales Beckham delivers a message titled "Modern Pioneers."

title: Our Testimony to the World
preview: God is at the helm. We will seek His direction. We will listen to the still, small voice of revelation. And we will go forward as He directs.

title: Pioneers All
preview: President Thomas S. Monson delivers a message titled "Pioneers All."

title: Power of the Priesthood
preview: Caring for others is the very essence of priesthood responsibility. It is the power to bless, to heal, and to administer the saving ordinances of the gospel.

title: “Pray unto the Father in My Name”
preview: When we use these sacred words, “in the name of Jesus Christ,” … we are on holy ground.

title: “That Spirit Which Leadeth to Do Good”
preview: The Holy Ghost will be our constant companion if we submit ourselves to the will of our Father in Heaven.

title: The Basics Have Not Changed
preview: Learn to be … obedient above all things—that you might be able to carry out the Lord’s work in the majestic way in which it must be done.

title: They Showed the Way
preview: Jesus Christ, Savior of the world … was and is the ultimate pioneer, for He has gone before, showing all others the way to follow.

title: They Will Come
preview: Let us, with faith unwavering and with love unstinting, be bridge builders to the hearts of those with whom we labor.

title: “True to the Faith”
preview: With so great an inheritance, we can do no less than our very best. Those who have gone before expect this of us. We have a mandate from the Lord.

title: “True to the Truth”
preview: [Your] most important stewardship is the glorious responsibility your Father in Heaven has given you to watch over and care for your own soul.

title: Washed Clean
preview: Imagine the consoling, liberating, exalting feeling that will come to you when you see the reality of the Atonement and the practical, everyday value of it to you individually.

title: “When Thou Art Converted, Strengthen Thy Brethren”
preview: To become one in the family of Saints requires established members of the Church to warmly welcome new members with open arms.

title: “You Have Nothing to Fear from the Journey”
preview: No matter how difficult the trail … we can take comfort in knowing that others before us have borne life’s most grievous trials and tragedies by looking to heaven.

title: A Celestial Connection to Your Teenage Years
preview: If you want to become the person the Lord wants you to be, you had better work on it today, because it is a true principle that we become what we do.

title: “Apply the Atoning Blood of Christ”
preview: Christ paid such an enormous, enabling price for us! Will we not apply His Atonement in order to pay the much smaller price required for personal progress?

title: “Are You the Woman I Think You Are?”
preview: Am I … the woman I want to be? More importantly, am I the woman the Savior needs me to be?

title: “Behold the Man”
preview: Our vision of you and your work looks beyond the outward appearance of a boy and sees instead a bearer of the holy priesthood outfitted with its attendant powers, duties, and blessings.

title: Called to Serve
preview: It is not in the proper spirit for us to decide where we will serve or where we will not. We serve where we are called.

title: Care for New Converts
preview: In building the kingdom of God, every positive act, every friendly greeting, every warm smile, every thoughtful, kind note contributes to the strength of the whole.

title: Creating Places of Security
preview: A righteous woman’s strength and influence are great. Her opportunities to create safe havens for struggling souls are abundant.

title: “Daughter, Be of Good Comfort”
preview: Legion are the stories that could and need to be told of women valiant in their testimonies of Jesus Christ who are unsung heroines in our midst.

title: Drawing Nearer to the Lord
preview: God is our Father who watches over His kingdom. Jesus is the Christ whose name this Church bears. He stands at its head.

title: “Feed My Lambs”
preview: The Saints of God have always been under covenant to nourish each other spiritually, especially those tender in the gospel.

title: Following the Pioneers
preview: Do you, like the pioneers, have the courage and the consistency to be true to the faith and endure to the end?

title: “For Such a Time as This”
preview: Our time has come. We must possess the spiritual strength to overcome our challenges, laying our faults on the altar and giving our lives to the Lord.

title: Four Absolute Truths Provide an Unfailing Moral Compass
preview: There is a loving Father in Heaven, and His Son, Jesus Christ; there is an adversary, Satan; through agency, all of us choose our own course; the temptations of the devil can always be overcome.

title: “He Hath Filled the Hungry with Good Things”
preview: Everything in the gospel teaches us that we can change if we need to, that we can be helped if we truly want it, that we can be made whole, whatever the problems of the past.

title: Home Teaching—a Divine Service
preview: Can we … reach out to those for whom we are responsible and bring them to the table of the Lord to feast on His word and to enjoy the companionship of His Spirit?

title: Hymn of the Obedient: “All Is Well”
preview: What a wonderful future we have for the Church. All of these things are dependent upon how we accept the truth, how we live the principles of the gospel.

title: In Remembrance of Jesus
preview: Jesus is the great Mediator. Through omnipotent and omniscient, all-powerful and all-knowing, He is our friend.

title: Latter-day Saints in Very Deed
preview: I love you. I love the people of this Church. I love all who are faithful. I love all who follow the ways of the Lord.

title: Look to the Future
preview: The key to the success of the work will be the faith of all who call themselves Latter- day Saints.

title: Making Faith a Reality
preview: Fundamentals of daily living—scripture reading, prayer, family home evening, the conversation at dinner—these provide the experiences that make faith a reality.

title: Pioneer Shoes through the Ages
preview: By strengthening each other spiritually, building faith and fellowship, we wear the shoes of pioneers.

title: Pioneers of the Future: “Be Not Afraid, Only Believe”
preview: We belong to the greatest cause on earth. We are the pioneers of the future. Let us go forth like the armies of Helaman and build the kingdom of God.

title: Receive Truth
preview: Gaining a knowledge of Him is fundamental to our mortal training. We also need to have a thirst and a desire to become acquainted with the doctrines of the kingdom.

title: Some Thoughts on Temples, Retention of Converts, and Missionary Service
preview: May you look upon the Church as your great and good friend, your refuge when the world appears to be closing around you, your hope when things are dark, your pillar of fire.

title: Spiritual Capacity
preview: We need an example—someone to show us how spiritual capacity can be developed. I have selected as a model … President Gordon B. Hinckley.

title: Standing for Truth and Right
preview: Standing for truth and right is not solely a Sunday thing. Every day our neighborhoods and communities are in desperate need of our support and our commitment to safety and law and order.

title: Teach the Children
preview: Children learn through gentle direction and persuasive teaching. They search for models to imitate, knowledge to acquire, things to do, and teachers to please.

title: Teachers, the Timeless Key
preview: Regardless of life’s circumstances or the nature of one’s calling, all members of the Church have the opportunity to teach and to testify.

title: The Home: A Refuge and Sanctuary
preview: May [The Family: A Proclamation to the World] become the guideline and standard by which we live in our homes and raise our children.

title: The Lord Blesses His Children through Patriarchal Blessings
preview: Patriarchal blessings are … similar to a road map that indicates the paths that may be traveled and destinations that may be reached if we stay within those paths.

title: The Mighty Strength of the Relief Society
preview: May we gain knowledge through study. May we make home a heaven. May we find joy in service.

title: The Plan of Salvation: A Flight Plan for Life
preview: What a great and wonderful plan is the plan of salvation, which … teaches true principles to allow completion of our journey through life.

title: The Weightier Matters of the Law: Judgment, Mercy, and Faith
preview: We are to focus on the inward things of the heart, which we know and value intuitively but often neglect for that which is trivial, superficial, or prideful.

title: Universal Application of the Gospel
preview: The gospel of Jesus Christ has universal application. Since the beginning, it was designed to bless the lives of everyone, without exception.

title: Valued Companions
preview: In … Church meetings around the world, we come together seeking companionship— the good company of brothers and sisters in the gospel and the comfort of sweet communion with the Spirit of God.

title: Why Every Member a Missionary?
preview: How seriously have you personally taken the Lord’s charge to share His gospel? It is a lifelong responsibility … to be addressed differently according to the various seasons of your life.

title: A Disciple, a Friend
preview: The real issue is not how others define us but how the Savior defines us.

title: A New Harvest Time
preview: A new era of family history work has arrived.

title: “A Teacher Come from God”
preview: We must revitalize and reenthrone superior teaching in the Church—at home, from the pulpit, in our administrative meetings, and surely in the classroom.

title: Agency and Anger
preview: A cunning part of [Satan’s] strategy is to dissociate anger from agency, making us believe that we are victims of an emotion that we cannot control.

title: “Behold, We Count Them Happy Which Endure”
preview: We cannot expect to learn endurance in our later years if we have developed the habit of quitting when things get difficult now.

title: Bridging the Gap between Uncertainty and Certainty
preview: This marvelous Restoration has provided that which we need to recognize misguided philosophies and lifestyles not pleasing to our Heavenly Father.

title: Children and the Family
preview: Strong family relationships don’t just happen. It takes time. It takes commitment, it takes prayer, and it takes work.

title: Christ Can Change Human Behavior
preview: When our converts “come alive”—and they need nourishment—in the gospel, they soon come alive as students, as parents, in their professions, and as citizens.

title: Come unto Christ
preview: We want to come unto Christ because it is only in Him and through Him that we can return to the Father.

title: Have You Been Saved?
preview: As Latter-day Saints use the words saved and salvation, there are at least six different meanings.

title: How Near to the Angels
preview: You will become great women if you are united in the angelic cause of doing good and if you hunger and thirst after righteousness.

title: In Harm’s Way
preview: There is a battle of significant consequence taking place in the lives of young men today. In simple terms, it is the struggle between doing right or doing wrong.

title: Live the Commandments
preview: Take advantage of this great opportunity in your life to live it well, to be good, to have good works, and to influence other people for good.

title: Living Worthy of the Girl You Will Someday Marry
preview: Make yourself worthy of the loveliest girl in all the world. Keep yourself worthy through all the days of your life.

title: Look to God and Live
preview: Whenever we are inclined to feel burdened down with the blows of life, let us remember that others have passed the same way, have endured, and then have overcome.

title: Marvelous Are the Revelations of the Lord
preview: We need to embrace, study, and appreciate the revealed truths that are ours. We need to declare the gospel generously and kindly to all of our Father’s children.

title: Missionary Service
preview: The excitement and thrill of being a full-time missionary is one of the greatest blessings a young man of the Aaronic Priesthood can aspire to.

title: New Temples to Provide “Crowning Blessings” of the Gospel
preview: May the windows of heaven be opened and blessings be showered down upon us as a people as we walk with boldness and in faith before the Lord to accomplish His eternal work.

title: Obedience—Life’s Great Challenge
preview: The Lord recognizes that many of us tend to stray from His counsel when all is going well with us, yet when trouble comes we seek after Him and His blessings.

title: “Put Your Shoulder to the Wheel”
preview: Work is always a spiritual necessity even if, for some, work is not an economic necessity.

title: Removing Barriers to Happiness
preview: Appreciation for ethnic, cultural, or national heritage can be very wholesome and beneficial, but it can also perpetuate patterns of life that should be set aside by a devoted Latter-day Saint.

title: “Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart”
preview: Ordinances and covenants … are the vehicles the Lord has provided to conduct us into eternal life.

title: Teaching Our Children to Love the Scriptures
preview: Through the guidance of loving parents and dedicated teachers, small children can become familiar with the scriptures and the spirit that accompanies them.

title: Testimony
preview: This thing which we call testimony is the great strength of the Church. It is the wellspring of faith and activity. It is difficult to explain. It is difficult to quantify … , yet it is as real and powerful as any force on the earth.

title: That We May Be One
preview: The Savior of the world spoke of that unity and how we will have our natures changed to make it possible.

title: The Articles of Faith
preview: If you will use them as a guide to direct your studies of the Savior’s doctrine, you will find yourselves prepared to declare your witness of the restored, true church of the Lord.

title: “The Heart and a Willing Mind”
preview: You can do so much good that it will astound you as you are changed and as you see others changed.

title: The Kingdom’s Perfecting Pathway
preview: As we invest our time, talents, and means to build Zion, our hearts are purified, our wisdom increases, celestial habits begin to form.

title: The Relief Society
preview: Sisters, you must graduate from thinking that you only attend Relief Society to feeling that you belong to it!

title: The Time to Prepare
preview: The days of our probation are numbered, but none of us knows the number of those days. Each day of preparation is precious.

title: Tithing: A Privilege
preview: You and I are now among those generations given the privilege to know and to live the law of the tithe. The blessings that flow from obedience to that law are both temporal and spiritual.

title: Turning Hearts to the Family
preview: Heavenly Father has a plan for His children and … families are the central part of that plan.

title: Understanding Our True Identity
preview: Long ago you and I were born as daughters in our Heavenly Father’s family. … Each one of you was a valiant and noble woman in your premortal life.

title: We Bear Witness of Him
preview: Let us be true disciples of the Christ, observing the Golden Rule, doing unto others as we would have them do unto us.

title: “We Seek After These Things”
preview: We hope you are men who are “true at all times in whatsoever thing [you are] entrusted.” [Alma 53:20] … I plead for greater consistency between our beliefs and actions.

title: Young Women—Titles of Liberty
preview: You don’t have to be Captain Moroni to make a difference. Our Father in Heaven needs you to be who you are, in your family. He planned it that way.

title: A Season of Opportunity
preview: It is a season to reach out to touch the life of someone, a season to commit to keeping the Sabbath day holy, and a season to help keep the lights of our temples burning brightly.

title: A Voice of Warning
preview: Our ability to touch others with our warning voice matters to all who are covenant disciples of Jesus Christ.

title: Are We Keeping Pace?
preview: Every council … should be working together on ways to be more effective in preparing our members … to enjoy all the blessings of the Church and … the temple.

title: “As for Me and My House, We Will Serve the Lord”
preview: There is not anything a young man can do that will be any more important than serving a full-time mission.

title: Bear Record of Him
preview: In a society of unstable values and confusing voices, testimony can be the means by which parents give children an anchor for their faith.

title: Benediction
preview: These are momentous times in which we are living as Saints of the Most High. … Let us go on rearing our children in righteousness and truth. Let us be good neighbors and good friends.

title: “By What Power … Have Ye Done This?”
preview: The priesthood of God has become the eminent power for good in the world. … This great power … has been entrusted to us; we must not weaken it by failing in our responsibilities.

title: Come, Let Us Walk in the Light of the Lord
preview: His arms are open to each of us. His truths are plain and clear, and His invitation is sure.

title: “Come, Listen to a Prophet’s Voice”
preview: If we listen to the voice of the Lord through His living prophet and follow his counsel, we will never go astray.

title: Come to Relief Society
preview: It matters not where you come from, what your weaknesses are, what you look like— you belong here! The Lord loves you—each of you, collectively and individually.

title: Cultivating Divine Attributes
preview: We will attain new levels of spirituality and place our lives in closer harmony with Jesus the Christ based on how fully faith, hope, and charity become integral components of our lives.

title: Establishing the Church
preview: Establishing His Church is a unique assignment. We must take the gospel of Jesus Christ to all people in their own language without defiling the purity of the message.

title: Gratitude
preview: The depth and the willingness with which we serve is a direct reflection of our gratitude.

title: Healing Soul and Body
preview: If we seek the truth, develop faith in Him, and … sincerely repent, we will receive a spiritual change of heart which only comes from our Savior. Our hearts will become new again.

title: Hope through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
preview: Real hope is much more than wishful musing. It stiffens, not slackens, the spiritual spine.

title: Obeying the Law—Serving One’s Neighbor
preview: Obeying the Lord’s commandments is the best preparation to serve.

title: Opening the Windows of Heaven
preview: Tithing is a principle that is fundamental to the personal happiness and well-being of the Church members worldwide, both rich and poor.

title: Overcoming Discouragement
preview: If we place a little more patience in the process and a greater amount of faith in the Lord, our challenges will find their way toward successful conclusions.

title: Parents in Zion
preview: I do want to encourage leaders to carefully consider the home lest they issue calls or schedule activities which place an unnecessary burden on parents and families.

title: Pearls from the Sand
preview: Let us join in this great balanced effort for conversion, retention, and activation … to turn those grains of sand into pearls in our Father’s kingdom.

title: Personal Purity
preview: One who uses the God-given body of another without divine sanction abuses the very soul of that individual, abuses the central purpose and processes of life.

title: Small Temples—Large Blessings
preview: The simple presence of a temple should serve as a reminder of covenants we have made, the need for integrity, and the fact that God is never far away.

title: Sustaining the Prophets
preview: The gospel is true; it is the hope of the world; it will move onward to accomplish all that it must do.

title: The Aaronic Priesthood and the Sacrament
preview: Those who hold the Aaronic Priesthood open the door for all Church members who worthily partake of the sacrament to enjoy the companionship of the Spirit of the Lord and the ministering of angels.

title: The Living Prophet: Our Source of Pure Doctrine
preview: The Church is founded on continuing revelation to a current, living prophet.

title: The Power of Righteousness
preview: Choosing to do what the Lord has defined as right will, in the long run, always lead to the best outcomes.

title: The Priesthood Quorum
preview: Resolve now to do all within your power to make of your priesthood quorum one worthy of the name and one faithful to its mission.

title: Think to Thank
preview: Do we give thanks to God “for his unspeakable gift” [2 Cor. 9:15] and His rich blessings so abundantly bestowed upon us?

title: To the Boys and to the Men
preview: I am suggesting that the time has come to get our houses in order.

title: Today Determines Tomorrow
preview: Let each of us learn of Him, believe in Him, trust in Him, follow Him, obey Him. By so doing, we can become like Him.

title: Walking in the Light of the Lord
preview: My message to you, my challenge to you, my prayer is that you will rededicate yourselves to the strengthening of your homes.

title: We Are Children of God
preview: Who are we? We are children of God. Our potential is unlimited. Our inheritance is sacred.

title: We Are Not Alone
preview: We have been promised the constant companionship of the third member of the Godhead and hence the privilege of receiving revelation for our own lives.

title: Welcome to Conference
preview: With prayer and faith and in humility, testimony is borne to you. May we all be inspired together. May our hearts be lifted in praise to our Redeemer.

title: What Are People Asking about Us?
preview: I … wish to set forth, as simply as I know how, my response to what people are asking.

title: “Ye Also Shall Bear Witness”
preview: There are many on the earth who desire a witness of truth and earnestly seek the peace and joy promised by the Savior.

title: Youth of the Noble Birthright
preview: The only lasting joy and happiness you will ever find during your mortal experience will come by following the Savior.

title: Bridges and Eternal Keepsakes
preview: Genealogies, family stories, historical accounts, and traditions … form a bridge between past and future and bind generations together in ways that no other keepsake can.

title: Fellowshipping
preview: I know what it means to have a friend, a responsibility, and to be nurtured by the good word of God.

title: Find the Lambs, Feed the Sheep
preview: From a satellite broadcast given at the Salt Lake Tabernacle 21 February 1999

title: Follow the Light
preview: The Lord invites us to come out of the cold danger of worldliness and into the warmth of His light.

title: For I Was Blind, but Now I See
preview: If you want to give a light to others, you have to glow yourself.

title: Friendship: A Gospel Principle
preview: If we truly want to be tools in the hands of our Heavenly Father in bringing to pass His eternal purposes, we need only to be a friend.

title: Greed, Selfishness, and Overindulgence
preview: I am confident that we will literally be called upon to make an accounting before God concerning how we have used [our resources] to bless lives and build the kingdom.

title: “He Is Not Here, but Is Risen”
preview: These simple words—“He is not here, but is risen”—have become the most profound in all literature. … They are the fulfillment of all He had spoken concerning rising again.

title: Inspired Church Welfare
preview: The Savior, who set the pattern for us, is pleased with those who “remember in all things the poor and the needy, the sick and the afflicted” [D&C 52:40].

title: Like a Flame Unquenchable
preview: One thing is certain: the commandments have not changed. … Right is still right. Wrong is still wrong, no matter how cleverly cloaked in respectability or political correctness.

title: Love and Service
preview: Let me just remind all of you of the great need we have … for couple missionaries. … If you’re retired and wondering what to do with those extra years, there’s a world out there of excitement.

title: “Made Like unto the Son of God”
preview: There should be nothing casual, nonchalant, or indifferent about holding priesthood. Once accepted, it should not be ignored, neglected, or cast aside. It is a mantle of honor and power.

title: Obedience: The Path to Freedom
preview: Obedience leads to true freedom. The more we obey revealed truth, the more we become liberated.

title: Our Only Chance
preview: He knows how to succor all of us. But we activate the power of the Atonement in our lives … by seeking after Him.

title: Our Sacred Duty to Honor Women
preview: Thank the Lord for these sisters who—like our Heavenly Father—love us not only for what we are but for what we may become.

title: “Out of Small Things”
preview: May we take courage, faith, and comfort from the small, quiet, and gentle acts of caring, loving, humble, and dedicated followers of Christ.

title: Preparing Our Families for the Temple
preview: Our greatest challenge is to prepare our families for the temple. Parents have the primary responsibility, but grandparents, aunts and uncles, even brothers and sisters all may teach the family.

title: Priesthood and the Home
preview: There is a way for each ward through councils to reach out to … families [who do not have a priesthood holder] and to open the roads to the temple for them.

title: Receive the Temple Blessings
preview: It is a place of peace, solitude, and inspiration. Regular attendance will enrich your life with greater purpose.

title: “Repent of [Our] Selfishness” (D&C 56:8)
preview: Meekness is the real cure, for it does not merely mask selfishness but dissolves it!

title: Spiritual Power of Our Baptism
preview: How can we apply the spiritual power of our baptism to the principle of modesty? We hope one of the things that makes you different from the world is the way you dress.

title: Strengthening Families: Our Sacred Duty
preview: The key to strengthening our families is having the Spirit of the Lord come into our homes. The goal of our families is to be on the strait and narrow path.

title: Teach Them the Word of God with All Diligence
preview: Our teaching will be effective if we approach it humbly through prayer and study.

title: Thanks to the Lord for His Blessings
preview: Great are our blessings. Tremendous is our responsibility. Let us … march forward without fear to enlarge among people everywhere the righteousness of the Lord.

title: The Bishop and His Counselors
preview: The Church is no bigger than a ward. … Everything needed for our redemption, save for the temple, is centered there—and temples now come ever closer to all of us.

title: The Hands of the Fathers
preview: Surely the greatest of those things [required of fathers] will be to have done all they could for the happiness and spiritual safety of the children they are to nurture.

title: The Power of Teaching Doctrine
preview: We can teach even a child to understand the doctrine of Jesus Christ. It is therefore possible, with God’s help, to teach the saving doctrine simply.

title: The Priesthood—Mighty Army of the Lord
preview: One of the greatest safeguards we have in the Church is a strong, firm, committed, dedicated, and testifying Melchizedek Priesthood base.

title: The Shepherds of the Flock
preview: I carry in my heart a deep appreciation for our bishops. I am profoundly grateful for the revelation of the Almighty under which this office was created and functions.

title: The Witness: Martin Harris
preview: One of Martin Harris’s greatest contributions to the Church, for which he should be honored for all time, was his financing the publication of the Book of Mormon.

title: The Work Moves Forward
preview: The Church goes forward on its appointed mission in the direction of its appointed destiny.

title: This Is Our Day
preview: The marvels of modern science and technology will not exalt us. Indeed, the great challenge we face as we prepare for the future is to be more spiritually enlightened.

title: True Followers
preview: As His true followers, the Savior wants us to love others as He loves them—more unconditionally, more purely, more perfectly.

title: Welcome Home
preview: Have faith in Christ, trust Him, come unto Him, follow Him. … Step by step the way will unfold before you until … you are back where you belong.

title: Your Celestial Journey
preview: There will come those teaching times to each of you when you will witness the love of your mother, the strength of your father, and the inspiration of God.

title: Your Light in the Wilderness
preview: Keep your eyes riveted on your goal … and walk in the straight and narrow path of the Son—the Son of God.

title: Your Name Is Safe in Our Home
preview: There are those among us who would recoil in horror at the thought of stealing another person’s money or property but who don’t give a second thought to stealing another person’s good name or reputation.

title: A Testimony of the Book of Mormon
preview: When you read the Book of Mormon, concentrate on the principal figure in the book— from its first chapter to the last—the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: A Year of Jubilee
preview: Let us place higher priority on family prayer, family scripture study, and family home evenings and eliminate those activities that fill our lives with worldliness and evil.

title: Agency—A Blessing and a Burden
preview: Agency is the power to think, choose, and act for ourselves. It comes with endless opportunities, accompanied by responsibility and consequences.

title: “An High Priest of Good Things to Come”
preview: Some blessings come soon, some come late, and some don’t come until heaven; but for those who embrace the gospel of Jesus Christ, they come.

title: At the Summit of the Ages
preview: May God bless us with a sense of our place in history and … our need to stand tall and walk with resolution in a manner becoming the Saints of the Most High.

title: Becoming Our Best Selves
preview: When we [trust in the Lord], we will come to realize that we have been on His holy errand, that His divine purposes have been fulfilled, and that we have shared in that fulfillment.

title: “Behold the Man”
preview: A true man is strong enough to withstand the wiles of Satan and humble enough to submit himself to the redemptive powers of the Savior.

title: Beware of False Prophets and False Teachers
preview: Beware of those who speak and publish in opposition to God’s true prophets.

title: Do Not Delay
preview: However difficult our circumstances, we can repent.

title: “Feed My Sheep”
preview: I believe that every active member of the Church knows a lost sheep who needs the attention and love of a caring shepherd.

title: “For This Cause Came I into the World”
preview: The symbol of Jesus and His place in our hearts must be a life given fully to His service, to loving and caring.

title: Good-bye to This Wonderful Old Tabernacle
preview: The Spirit of the Lord has been in this [Tabernacle]. It is sacred unto us. We hope, we anticipate, we pray that the new [Conference Center] will likewise radiate the same spirit.

title: Gospel Teaching
preview: In our sacred callings of gospel teaching, no effort is too good for the work of the Lord and the growth of His children.

title: Growing into the Priesthood
preview: The Atonement of Jesus Christ has given the Savior the power to help you grow into the young man He knows you can be.

title: He Lives
preview: He [Jesus Christ] has given His life that even in our weakness, we may overcome our mistakes through repentance and obedience to His gospel.

title: Home, Family, and Personal Enrichment
preview: We are eager for each sister to strengthen herself spiritually and to acquire skills that will be crucial in meeting the challenges that are ahead.

title: Hope, an Anchor of the Soul
preview: Our greatest hope comes from the knowledge that the Savior broke the bands of death. … He atoned for our sins if we repent.

title: Lessons from Laman and Lemuel
preview: Laman and Lemuel became rebels instead of leaders, resentful instead of righteous —all because of their failure to understand either the character or the purposes of God.

title: “No Man Is an Island”
preview: New members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints cannot make it alone. … They need us and we need them.

title: Of Seeds and Soils
preview: We particularly want you young men to have a strong testimony, with solid roots, because only then will it be an unerring compass for you.

title: One Link Still Holds
preview: As the world moves deeper and deeper into sin, this wonderful Church stands like a giant granite boulder.

title: Our Destiny
preview: The center of the plan is the Lord Jesus Christ. Reject or ignore Him, and the great plan of happiness cannot function in your behalf.

title: Our Legacy
preview: What are we doing to ensure that [our] legacy is being passed to our beloved children and to our grandchildren?

title: Peace, Hope, and Direction
preview: Let us rejoice in the blessings of peace, hope, and direction, blessings that so many of our Father’s children do not enjoy.

title: Priesthood Power
preview: The priesthood is not really so much a gift as it is a commission to serve, a privilege to lift, and an opportunity to bless the lives of others.

title: Prophets and Spiritual Mole Crickets
preview: In modern Israel, serving the Lord means carefully following the Prophets.

title: Rejoice, Daughters of Zion
preview: Women throughout the world will be drawn to the Church as we perfect our lives and live essential truths to light the way for others to follow.

title: Righteousness
preview: No other feeling in the soul of man can bring the joy and happiness than that of knowing you are doing all you can to become righteous.

title: Serving the Lord
preview: We cannot choose to serve God and the world at the same time.

title: Spiritual Hurricanes
preview: Our watchmen on the tower are known to us as apostles and prophets. They are our spiritual eyes in the sky.

title: The Faith of a Sparrow: Faith and Trust in the Lord Jesus Christ
preview: When He reveals to us, speaking through our living prophet today, that we need to do more, … then we need to step forward and say, “Here am I; send me”!

title: The Spirit of Revelation
preview: Young Latter-day Saints, shape up! Face up! Take hold of your lives! Take control of your mind, your thoughts!

title: “The Tongue of Angels”
preview: What we say and how we present ourselves not only betray our inner person but also mold that person, those around us, and finally our whole society.

title: We Are Women of God
preview: Coming unto Christ means walking away from the world. It means placing Christ and Christ only at the center of our lives.

title: Welcome to Conference
preview: The Church grows ever larger. It touches more and more lives for good. It is spreading over the earth in a wonderful way.

title: What It Means to Be a Daughter of God
preview: The commitment and dedication of the sisters of this Church have been since the beginning a marvelous, strengthening ingredient.

title: Why We Do Some of the Things We Do
preview: This … is not a cause of ease nor a work without effort, even sacrifice. We shall go on pursuing the path which the Lord has marked out before us.

title: A Brief Introduction to the Church
preview: We declare that the great restoration that the ancient prophets spoke of began in 1820 when the Lord called a young man named Joseph Smith to reestablish the Church.

title: A Temple for West Africa
preview: It has been inspiring to see the Lord’s hand in bringing the forces together which will lead to an inevitable victory. There will be a temple in West Africa.

title: A Time of New Beginnings
preview: Let us take a little time to meditate, to think of what we can do to improve our lives and to become better examples of what a Latter-day Saint should be.

title: “Are You Still Here?”
preview: I have learned from the scriptures and the living prophets that this life is the time to prepare ourselves to meet God and one day enjoy eternal life with Him.

title: As Doves to Our Windows
preview: May we do as much with the blessings we have been given as [our ancestors] did out of the deprivations so many of them faced. In such abundance may we never “forget the Lord.”

title: “Because My Father Sent Me”
preview: A father succeeds when he steps forward and accepts his commitment as a father, always loving, praying for and doing what he can for his family, and never giving up.

title: Content with the Things Allotted unto Us
preview: Life’s necessary defining moments come within our allotments. … Our responses are what matter. Sufficient unto each life are the tests thereof!

title: Faith, Devotion, and Gratitude
preview: I hope that we have grateful hearts for the knowledge that we have and the testimonies we have and for the feelings we have.

title: Finding a Safe Harbor
preview: In our own storms in life the Savior is our solace and our sanctuary. If we seek peace, we must come unto Him.

title: Future Leaders
preview: I pray that you young people will develop a reverence for sacred things, a respect for your elders, and a willingness to keep the commandments. I pray that you will learn to know of the Savior.

title: Heavenly Father Has a Special Plan
preview: I know that your Heavenly Father has a special plan for you and your family to return to live with Him. Let’s go home.

title: Honoring the Priesthood
preview: Priesthood isn’t something we take off during the week and put on for Sunday. It is a 24-7 privilege and blessing—that is, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

title: “How Is It with Us?”
preview: The most important thing every one of us can do is to examine our own commitment and devotion to the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Integrity
preview: Integrity makes you whole and complete.

title: Keep an Eternal Perspective
preview: If we can help people first understand the plan, they will find a deeper and more permanent motivation to keep the commandments.

title: Living Happily Ever After
preview: The Savior, Jesus Christ, showed us the way to happiness and told us everything we need to do to be happy.

title: My Testimony
preview: Of all the things for which I feel grateful … , one stands out preeminently. That is a living testimony of Jesus Christ.

title: Resurrection
preview: Resurrection is much more than merely reuniting a spirit to a body. … The resurrection is a restoration that brings back “carnal for carnal” and “good for that which is good” (Alma 41:13).

title: Stand as a Witness
preview: You have all you need to stand strong and firm and true because you have the Lord on your side.

title: Standing with God
preview: What does it mean to stand as a witness of God? It means we will not bow down or give in or be persuaded to do anything contrary to God’s will.

title: The Cloven Tongues of Fire
preview: In every language, the Spirit of God—the Holy Ghost—guides, or can guide, every member of the Church.

title: The Creation
preview: Grand as it is, planet Earth is part of something even grander—that great plan of God. Simply summarized, the earth was created that families might be.

title: The Power of Self-Mastery
preview: Self-mastery … is the ultimate test of our character.

title: The Sanctity of Womanhood
preview: Each of us absolutely must help each daughter of God we can to realize what sacred characteristics Father in Heaven has given her.

title: The Shield of Faith
preview: Never before in the history of the world has the need for faith in God been greater.

title: The Stake President
preview: Stake presidents have been called under the same inspiration under which the General Authorities were called. I pray for these, my beloved brethren, that the Spirit of the Lord will rest upon them.

title: The Widows of Zion
preview: The Lord loves widows. … [We] should care for and assist the widows within our family, home, ward, and neighborhood.

title: “Thou Shalt Give Heed unto All His Words”
preview: The continued expansion of technology will only bring the messages to us. … [But it is] the challenge of each individual and family … to internalize the messages of the gospel.

title: To All the World in Testimony
preview: In this great hall … the voices of prophets will go out to all the world in testimony of the Redeemer of mankind.

title: Watch Over and Strengthen
preview: The Savior will let you feel the love He feels for those you serve. The call is an invitation to become like Him.

title: We Are Creators
preview: Create homes filled with love and serenity. Relieve suffering. Create enduring testimonies of eternal truths in ourselves and others.

title: Womanhood: The Highest Place of Honor
preview: I promise you dear young sisters that if you live the standards of personal worthiness contained in the Young Women program, great will be your happiness and endless will be your joy.

title: Your Eternal Home
preview: In a very real sense, we are builders of eternal houses. We are apprentices to the trade—not skilled craftsmen. We need divine help if we are to build successfully.

title: Your Eternal Voyage
preview: Let us consider our callings, let us reflect on our responsibilities, let us determine our duty, and let us follow Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: Your Own Personal Testimony
preview: The Holy Ghost has the power to bring light and understanding to our lives, but we must pay the price to seek and win His companionship.

title: A Great Family in Reverence and Worship
preview: We speak words of testimony concerning God our Eternal Father and His Beloved Son.

title: A Growing Testimony
preview: As I look back over my life, I recognize one source of singular strength and blessing. It is my testimony and knowledge that Jesus is the Christ.

title: “An Humble and a Contrite Heart”
preview: If we have drawn nearer to the Savior, with a more firm resolution to follow His teachings and His example, then this conference will have been a wonderful success.

title: Be a Strong Link
preview: As my eyesight dims somewhat, I think my vision improves—my vision of the long road, my vision of what lies ahead.

title: “Come and See”
preview: Come seeking to know Him, and I promise you will find Him and see Him in His true character as the risen, redeeming Savior of the world.

title: Cultivate Righteous Traditions
preview: Uplifting traditions … that promote love for Deity and unity in families and among people are especially important.

title: Dedication Day
preview: As an expression of our love for the Lord, could we not rededicate our lives and our homes in a like manner?

title: Discipleship
preview: We must create … ongoing and continual processes that draw us closer to the Lord our Savior so that we can be numbered among His disciples.

title: Freedom “from” or Freedom “to”
preview: We … become alive as we take, knowingly, full responsibility for our own life and as we stop blaming circumstances.

title: “Great Shall Be the Peace of Thy Children”
preview: In terms of your happiness, in terms of the matters that make you proud or sad, nothing—I repeat, nothing—will have so profound an effect on you as the way your children turn out.

title: “Lead, Kindly Light”
preview: The light of Jesus Christ is stronger than any darkness we face in this life, if we have faith in Him, seek after Him, and obey Him.

title: Living by Scriptural Guidance
preview: We all need guidance through life. We obtain it best from the standard works and teachings of the prophets of God.

title: Living Prophets, Seers, and Revelators
preview: There is an expanding gulf between the standards of the world and those of the gospel and kingdom of God, and … living prophets will always teach the standards of God.

title: Now Is the Time
preview: If we do not … willingly teach others of the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ through the Prophet Joseph Smith, who will?

title: One by One
preview: Embrace the Savior’s warm invitation to come unto Him, one by one, and be perfected in Him.

title: Pure Testimony
preview: As a special witness of the name of Jesus Christ in all the world, I promise you that if you seek the Lord, you will find Him. Ask, and you shall receive.

title: Retaining a Remission of Sin
preview: King Benjamin taught three basic principles that can help us retain a remission of our sins: first, to remain humble; second, to call upon the Lord daily; and third, to stand steadfast in the faith.

title: Ripples
preview: The actions of righteous women ripple on and on through time and space and even generations.

title: “Sanctify Yourselves”
preview: The call in every age—and especially our age—is Joshua’s call: “Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.”

title: Satan’s Bag of Snipes
preview: Will we listen to Satan, the author of all lies … ? Or are we going to believe a loving Heavenly Father, who is the source of all truth and happiness?

title: Seeking the Spirit of God
preview: As we become more conversant with the Holy Spirit, our lives become refined. The sordid and base have no attraction.

title: Sharing the Gospel
preview: Given the importance of the message, the help offered by the Spirit, the number of the missionaries and the size of the field that is ready to harvest, 300,000 new converts per year is not nearly enough.

title: Stand Tall and Stand Together
preview: No woman is a more vibrant instrument in the hands of the Lord than a woman of God who is thrilled to be who she is.

title: Testimony
preview: I know that God our Father is in this work in great congregations such as this, and in the smallest branch and the smallest congregation God is in this work.

title: The Blessing of Keeping the Sabbath Day Holy
preview: The Latter-day Saints must lead out in sanctifying this appointed day each week.

title: The Call to Serve
preview: I revere the priesthood of Almighty God. I have witnessed its power. I have seen its strength. I have marveled at the miracles it has wrought.

title: The Challenge to Become
preview: In contrast to the institutions of the world, which teach us to know something, the gospel of Jesus Christ challenges us to become something.

title: The Covenant of Baptism: To Be in the Kingdom and of the Kingdom
preview: Our Baptism and confirmation is the gateway into His kingdom. When we enter, we covenant to be of His kingdom—forever!

title: The Enemy Within
preview: Each of us needs to train ourselves to be bold, disciplined, and loyal men of the priesthood who are prepared with the proper weapons to fight against evil and to win.

title: The Joy of Womanhood
preview: Daughters of God know that it is the nurturing nature of women that can bring everlasting blessings, and they live to cultivate this divine attribute.

title: The Path to Peace and Joy
preview: Are you taking full advantage of the redeeming power of repentance in your life so that you can have greater peace and joy?

title: The Redemption of the Dead and the Testimony of Jesus
preview: By identifying our ancestors and performing for them the saving ordinances they could not themselves perform, we are testifying of the infinite reach of the Atonement of Jesus Christ.

title: The Tugs and Pulls of the World
preview: Many individuals preoccupied by the cares of the world are not necessarily in transgression. But they certainly are in diversion and thus waste “the days of [their] probation” (2 Ne. 9:27).

title: This Great Millennial Year
preview: This work is possessed of a vitality which has never been evidenced before to such a degree.

title: We Are Instruments in the Hands of God
preview: We don’t need a new program to spur us on—we need only incorporate the desire to share the gospel and reach out to new members and those who are less active.

title: “Write upon My Heart”
preview: Prayer can provide the shield of protection the parent will want so much for [a child] to have.

title: “Ye Are the Temple of God”
preview: Your body really is the instrument of your mind and the foundation of your character.

title: Your Greatest Challenge, Mother
preview: I know of no better answer to [the] foul practices that confront our young people than the teachings of a mother, given in love with an unmistakable warning.

title: A Comforter, a Guide, a Testifier
preview: By the gift and power of the Holy Ghost, you can be guided in your trip through life.

title: A God of Miracles
preview: I believe that all of us can bear witness to these small miracles.

title: An Invitation with Promise
preview: Just being a member of this Church is not enough. Nor is merely going through the motions of membership sufficient.

title: Born Again
preview: The full benefit of forgiveness of sin through the Savior’s Atonement begins with repentance and baptism and then expands upon receiving the Holy Ghost.

title: Building a Community of Saints
preview: In any community of Saints, we all work to serve each other in the best way we know how. Our work has a higher purpose because it is work to bless others and to build the kingdom of God.

title: Building the Kingdom
preview: From its earliest days, the Lord’s Church has been built up by ordinary people who magnified their callings in humility and devotion.

title: Compassion
preview: We have no way of knowing when our privilege to extend a helping hand will unfold before us.

title: Couple Missionaries: A Time to Serve
preview: It is proper for a mature sister or couple to let their priesthood leaders know that they are willing and able to serve a mission. I urge you to do so.

title: David, a Future Missionary
preview: Given some exposure, our young brothers and young sisters come quite naturally … to a deep love for Jesus and for our prophets.

title: Developing Our Talent for Spirituality
preview: Spirituality is learning how to listen to the Spirit and then letting it govern our lives.

title: Enhancing Our Temple Experience
preview: There is a difference in just attending the temple and having a rich spiritual experience.

title: First Things First
preview: Do the best you can while on earth to have an ideal family. To help you do that, ponder and apply the principles in the proclamation on the family.

title: Focus and Priorities
preview: Available information wisely used is far more valuable than multiplied information allowed to lie fallow.

title: Good-bye for Another Season
preview: These conferences are held … to strengthen our testimonies of this work, to fortify us against temptation and sin, to lift our sights, to receive instruction.

title: Gratitude and Service
preview: May you have a burning feeling in your heart. May you feel as I do on this day that this work is true and that it is meant for us to help bring about the eternal plan of salvation and exaltation.

title: “His Word Ye Shall Receive”
preview: It is no small thing, my brothers and sisters, to have a prophet of God in our midst. Great and wonderful are the blessings that come into our lives as we listen to the word of the Lord given to us through him.

title: How Can I Become the Woman of Whom I Dream?
preview: You are daughters of the Almighty. Limitless is your potential. Magnificent is your future, if you will take control of it.

title: Personal Preparation for Temple Blessings
preview: Those who enter the temple are also to bear the attribute of holiness. … We can acquire holiness only by enduring and persistent personal effort.

title: “Plow in Hope”
preview: By utilizing the Atonement, we access the gifts of the Holy Ghost, which “filleth with hope and perfect love” (Moro. 8:26).

title: Priesthood Power
preview: While the power of the priesthood is unlimited, our individual power in the priesthood is limited by our degree of righteousness or purity.

title: Sacrifice: An Eternal Investment
preview: Sacrifice is an amazing principle. … It can develop within us a profound love for each other and our Savior, Jesus Christ.

title: The Law of the Fast
preview: Fasting, coupled with mighty prayer, is powerful. It can fill our minds with the revelations of the Spirit. It can strengthen us against times of temptation.

title: The Miracle of Faith
preview: Faith is the basis of testimony. Faith underlies loyalty to the Church. Faith represents sacrifice, gladly given in moving forward the work of the Lord.

title: The Perpetual Education Fund
preview: Where there is widespread poverty among our people, we must do all we can to help them to lift themselves, to establish their lives upon a foundation of self-reliance that can come of training. Education is the key to opportunity.

title: “The Touch of the Master’s Hand”
preview: We all make mistakes. … It is then in our nature to feel guilt and humiliation and suffering, which we alone cannot cure. That is when the healing power of the Atonement will help.

title: The Work Goes On
preview: Let us be good people. Let us be friendly people. Let us be neighborly people. Let us be what members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints ought to be.

title: “Them That Honour Me I Will Honour”
preview: Honor four sacred principles in your lives: reverence for Deity; respecting and honoring family relationships; reverence for and obedience to the ordinances and covenants of the holy priesthood; respect for yourself as a son of God.

title: “To Bear Testimony of Mine Only Begotten”
preview: A spiritual witness of the Nephite scripture will always bring the certainty of the Savior’s existence.

title: To the Rescue
preview: Brethren, the world is in need of your help. There are feet to steady, hands to grasp, minds to encourage, hearts to inspire, and souls to save.

title: “To Walk Humbly with Thy God”
preview: True humility will inevitably lead us to say to God, “Thy will be done.”

title: United in Love and Testimony
preview: Church members are unified in Christ through love and testimony. This dispensation’s pathway to our Savior is through Joseph and the Book of Mormon.

title: “Watch with Me”
preview: As you watch over His sheep, your love for Him will grow. And that will increase your confidence and your courage.

title: “Witnesses unto Me”
preview: For those who find it difficult to initiate missionary conversations—and many do—the Church’s newly produced pass-along cards are a lovely, effortless way to let others know some of your basic beliefs and how they may learn more.

title: You Can’t Pet a Rattlesnake
preview: Pornography, though billed by Satan as entertainment, is a deeply poisonous, deceptive snake that lies coiled up in magazines, the Internet, and the television.

title: Your Celestial Guide
preview: When you pray often and seek to know the Lord’s will like Nephi did, the Lord will show you the way.

title: Are We Not All Mothers?
preview: Motherhood is more than bearing children. … It is the essence of who we are as women.

title: “Be Thou an Example”
preview: Fill your mind with truth; fill your heart with love; fill your life with service.

title: Beware of Murmuring
preview: Obedience is essential to realize the blessings of the Lord.

title: Building a Bridge of Faith
preview: Our mortal life is the time for men to meet God by building a bridge of faith, opening the door into immortality and eternal life.

title: Create or Continue Priesthood Links
preview: When we serve righteously … , we are strengthening our priesthood link and connecting it ever more securely to those who have preceded and who will follow us.

title: Doctrine of Inclusion
preview: If we are truly disciples of the Lord Jesus Christ, we will reach out with love and understanding to all of our neighbors at all times.

title: Duty Calls
preview: All of us have a solemn duty to honor the priesthood and labor to bring many precious souls unto the Lord.

title: Faith of Our Prophets
preview: What we need is the faith of Brigham Young and the faith of Gordon B. Hinckley and the faith of people who are our prophets and leaders.

title: “Fear Not: For They That Be with Us Are More”
preview: We are not alone in this sacred trust of parenting, loving, and leading. There is no greater joy. It is worth every sacrifice.

title: Fulfilling Our Duty to God
preview: I promise you that your achievement of the Duty to God Award will provide you with a living testimony that will sustain you throughout your life.

title: Gratitude
preview: Gratitude may be increased by constantly reflecting on our blessings and giving thanks for them in our daily prayers.

title: “Help Thou Mine Unbelief”
preview: We promote the process of strengthening our faith when we do what is right—increased faith always follows.

title: It Is Not Good for Man or Woman to Be Alone
preview: No marriage or family, no ward or stake is likely to reach its full potential until husbands and wives, mothers and fathers, men and women work together in unity of purpose.

title: “Like a Watered Garden”
preview: We should pay [tithes and offerings] as a personal expression of love to a generous and merciful Father in Heaven.

title: Living in the Fulness of Times
preview: Notwithstanding the afflictions about us, notwithstanding the sordid things we see almost everywhere, notwithstanding the conflict that sweeps across the world, we can be better.

title: Now Is the Time
preview: May we live so that when that final summons is heard, we may have no serious regrets, no unfinished business.

title: One Step after Another
preview: We don’t have to be perfect today. We don’t have to be better than someone else. All we have to do is to be the very best we can.

title: Our Actions Determine Our Character
preview: In most encounters we can determine the kind of experience we are going to have by how we respond.

title: Our Duty to God
preview: Holding the priesthood and doing your duty to God is not only a very serious responsibility but also a remarkable privilege.

title: Our Father’s Plan
preview: [Our Heavenly] Father’s desire is to provide all of us with the opportunity to receive a fulness of joy, even the fulness that He possesses.

title: Prayer
preview: With … faith, we will be able to pray for what we want and appreciate whatever we get. Only with that faith will we pray with the diligence God requires.

title: Reaching Down to Lift Another
preview: Let us open our hearts, let us reach down and lift up, let us open our purses, let us show a greater love for our fellowmen.

title: “Set in Order Thy House”
preview: Our family is the focus of our greatest work and joy in this life; so will it be throughout all eternity.

title: Sharing the Gospel
preview: The most effective missionaries, member and full-time, always act out of love. … If we lack this love for others, we should pray for it.

title: “Some Great Thing”
preview: May we all be faithful in doing the day-to-day, ordinary things that prove our worthiness, for they will lead us to and qualify us for great things.

title: Stand Firm
preview: Let us never forget that we are building a foundation for and with our family upon the rock of our Redeemer.

title: Standing Tall
preview: Jesus Christ is our perfect example of one who always stood tall. He is the one who personifies integrity, strength, and courage.

title: Steadfast and Immovable
preview: We cannot abandon our faith when challenges comes our way. We will not turn away; we will not retreat; we will not become discouraged.

title: The Atonement: Our Greatest Hope
preview: Our salvation depends on believing in and accepting the Atonement. Such acceptance requires a continual effort to understand it more fully.

title: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ
preview: The Book of Mormon: Another Testament of Jesus Christ has the nourishing power to heal starving spirits of the world.

title: “The First and Great Commandment”
preview: Given the purpose of our existence, if we do not love God and neighbor, whatever else we do will be of little eternal consequence.

title: The Power of a Strong Testimony
preview: Your personal security and happiness depend upon the strength of your testimony, for it will guide your actions in times of trial or uncertainty.

title: The Returned Missionary
preview: What we need is a royal army of returned missionaries reenlisted into service.

title: The Seventh Commandment: A Shield
preview: The keeping of the seventh commandment is such a vital shield! By lowering or losing that shield, the much-needed blessings of heaven are lost.

title: The Times in Which We Live
preview: Our safety lies in repentance. Our strength comes of obedience to the commandments of God.

title: “Till We Meet Again”
preview: Our safety lies in the virtue of our lives. Our strength lies in our righteousness. God has made it clear that if we will not forsake Him, He will not forsake us.

title: Writing Gospel Principles in Our Hearts
preview: Knowledge alone is not enough. We must take time to apply the principles in our lives.

title: Becoming a Great Benefit to Our Fellow Beings
preview: I pray that you wonderful young men will not only be worthy to receive ministering angels, but that you … will become a ministering angel in the lives of others.

title: Becoming Men in Whom the Spirit of God Is
preview: The Lord is bound by solemn covenant to bless our lives according to our faithfulness. Only He can turn us into men in whom the Spirit of God, namely the Holy Ghost, is.

title: Being Teachable
preview: By being teachable, we activate the full force and blessings of the Atonement in our lives.

title: Charity: Perfect and Everlasting Love
preview: As we increasingly think and act like Him, the attributes of the natural man will slip away to be replaced by the heart and the mind of Christ.

title: Children
preview: There is in what we believe, there is in what we teach, counsel, commandments, even warnings that we are to protect, to love, to care for, and to “teach [children] to walk in the ways of truth.”

title: Consecrate Thy Performance
preview: In pondering and pursuing consecration, understandably we tremble inwardly at what may be required. Yet the Lord has said consolingly, “My grace is sufficient for you” (D&C 17:8).

title: Developing Inner Strength
preview: How do you and I become so converted to the truth, so full of faith, so dependent on God that we are able to meet trials and even be strengthened by them?

title: Eternal Life through Jesus Christ
preview: To know the Lord Jesus Christ, we and all mankind must receive Him. And to receive Him, we must receive His servants.

title: Faith Obedience
preview: “Faith obedience” is a matter of trust. The question is simple: Do we trust our Heavenly Father? Do we trust our prophets?

title: Feel the Love of the Lord
preview: If I could have one thing happen for every woman in this Church, it would be that they would feel the love of the Lord in their lives.

title: “Follow Me”
preview: Those who, in faith, leave their nets and follow the Savior will experience happiness beyond their ability to comprehend.

title: For Thy Good
preview: Out of our adversity we might seek our greatest triumphs, and the day may well come that from our challenges we will understand the familiar words “for thy good.”

title: Full Conversion Brings Happiness
preview: Your happiness now and forever is conditioned on your degree of conversion and the transformation that it brings to your life.

title: Hidden Wedges
preview: Let’s not pass to future generations the grievances, the anger of our time. Let’s remove any hidden wedges that can do nothing but destroy.

title: Hold High the Torch
preview: Develop the divinity that is within you. Don’t dull the brightness of the spirit you came with from heaven. The Lord needs your goodness and your influence in this world.

title: How Firm Our Foundation
preview: The foundation of one’s individual faith, if anchored firmly to eternal truth, allows each of us to reach upward with an eternal perspective.

title: I’ll Go Where You Want Me to Go
preview: I love Him. I want to do all that I can to serve as He would have me serve.

title: It Can’t Happen to Me
preview: Your future may not hold fame or fortune, but it can be something far more lasting and fulfilling. Remember that what we do in life echoes in eternity.

title: Out of Darkness into His Marvelous Light
preview: The emblems of the Savior’s Atonement remind us that we need not stumble in darkness. We can have His light with us always.

title: Pathways to Perfection
preview: Exemplify in your lives four tested, specific virtues: an attitude of gratitude, a longing for learning, a devotion to discipline, and a willingness to work.

title: Personal Worthiness to Exercise the Priesthood
preview: Our behavior in public must be above reproach. Our behavior in private is even more important. It must clear the standard set by the Lord.

title: Some Basic Teachings from the History of Joseph Smith
preview: Conversion is a personal and spiritual process. Every individual must examine these principles for himself.

title: Standing in Holy Places
preview: Standing in holy places is all about being in good company, whether you are alone or with others.

title: Strengthen Home and Family
preview: Three principles that will help you strengthen your home and family are nurturing, sacrifice, and prayer.

title: The Church Goes Forward
preview: No other church to come out of the soil of America has grown so fast nor spread so widely. … It is a phenomenon without precedent.

title: The Gospel in Our Lives
preview: He has given us His Atonement, His gospel, and His Church, a sacred combination that gives us the assurance of immortality and the opportunity for eternal life.

title: The Language of Love
preview: Every child needs regular reports affirming, “You are known. You are valued. You have potential. You are good.”

title: The Law of Tithing
preview: The Lord has established the law of tithing as the law of revenue of His Church. … It is also a law by which we show our loyalty to the Lord.

title: The Lifeline of Prayer
preview: Each of us has problems that we cannot solve and weaknesses that we cannot conquer without reaching out through prayer to a higher source of strength.

title: The Opportunity to Serve
preview: I know how deeply He loves us and how perfectly compelling His love is for us.

title: The Other Prodigal
preview: No one of us is less treasured or cherished of God than another. I testify that He loves each of us—insecurities, anxieties, self-image, and all.

title: The Peaceable Things of the Kingdom
preview: Peace—real peace, whole-souled to the very core of your being—comes only in and through faith in the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: They Pray and They Go
preview: Let us, as a mighty body of priesthood, be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Let us pray, then let us go and do.

title: This Road We Call Life
preview: As you stay on the right path, the reward at the end of life’s journey is well worth the moments of adversity you experience along the way.

title: True Friends
preview: All of us will be tested. And all of us need true friends to love us, to listen to us, to show us the way, and to testify of truth to us.

title: We Look to Christ
preview: Like the polar star in the heavens, … there stands the Redeemer of the world, the Son of God, certain and sure as the anchor of our immortal lives.

title: We Walk by Faith
preview: We reach toward the unknown, but faith lights the way. If we will cultivate that faith, we shall never walk in darkness.

title: A Voice of Gladness for Our Children
preview: This is our charge, this is our opportunity, to diligently teach and testify to our children of the truthfulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: A Woman of Faith
preview: A woman of faith trusts God. … She knows of His interest in her life. She knows that He knows her. She loves His words and drinks deeply of that living water.

title: “Blessed Are the Peacemakers”
preview: Peace is a prime priority that pleads for our pursuit.

title: Blessing Our Families through Our Covenants
preview: If we keep our covenants, the promises we receive in return are great.

title: But If Not
preview: Mortality’s supreme test is to face the “why” and then let it go, trusting humbly in the Lord’s promise that “all things must come to pass in their time.”

title: Called of God
preview: We have been given the great power of the priesthood. It blesses us individually and provides blessings for our family.

title: Called to Serve
preview: To raise our families and serve faithfully in the Church, all without running faster than we have strength, require wisdom, judgment, divine help—and inevitably some sacrifice.

title: Charity: One Family, One Home at a Time
preview: As covenant women, … we can alter the face of the earth one family and one home at a time through charity, our small and simple acts of pure love.

title: Come to Zion! Come to Zion!
preview: Principles of love, work, self-reliance, and consecration are God given. Those who embrace them and govern themselves accordingly become pure in heart.

title: Dad, Are You Awake?
preview: Do your sons ever wonder if you are asleep when it comes to the things that are most important to them?

title: Each a Better Person
preview: There is room for improvement in every life. … Regardless of our circumstances, we can improve ourselves and while so doing have an effect on the lives of those about us.

title: Encircled in the Arms of His Love
preview: Perplexing things will still happen, but, like Nephi, we can still know that God loves us, a … fact which can and will sustain us through so much!

title: Fun and Happiness
preview: We can feel happiness every day in our lives through little things we do, and we are fully happy as we keep the commandments of a loving God.

title: I Believe I Can, I Knew I Could
preview: While we are not all equal in experience, aptitude, and strength, … we will all be accountable for the use of the gifts and opportunities given to us.

title: I’ll Go Where You Want Me to Go
preview: The full measure of [our] conversion to men and women of God happens best through our labors in His vineyard.

title: Models to Follow
preview: All of us living in the world today need points of reference—even models to follow.

title: “O That I Were an Angel, and Could Have the Wish of Mine Heart”
preview: I urge you … to utilize the temples of the Church. Go there and carry forward the great and marvelous work which the God of heaven has outlined for us.

title: Peace, Be Still
preview: His words in holy writ are sufficient: “Be still, and know that I am God.”

title: Rise to Your Call
preview: The Lord will guide you by revelation just as He called you. You must ask in faith for revelation to know what you are to do.

title: Sacrifice Brings Forth the Blessings of Heaven
preview: If we are caring, if we are charitable, if we are obedient to God and follow His prophets, our sacrifices will bring forth the blessings of heaven.

title: Shall He Find Faith on the Earth?
preview: Only when our faith is aligned with the will of our Heavenly Father will we be empowered to receive the blessings we seek.

title: That They May Be One in Us
preview: We will not be one with God and Christ until we make Their will and interest our greatest desire.

title: The Global Church Blessed by the Voice of the Prophets
preview: Let us listen to the prophets of our days as they help us to focus on the things that are central to the Creator’s plan.

title: The Greatest Generation of Missionaries
preview: We call upon you, our young brethren of the Aaronic Priesthood, to rise up, to measure up, and to be fully prepared to serve the Lord.

title: The Marvelous Foundation of Our Faith
preview: God be thanked for His marvelous bestowal of testimony, authority, and doctrine associated with this, the restored Church of Jesus Christ.

title: The Stake Patriarch
preview: The Lord has a special interest in the patriarch, who holds a unique position in the Church.

title: Tithing: A Test of Faith with Eternal Blessings
preview: Pay your tithing. Unlock the windows of heaven. You will be abundantly blessed for your obedience and faithfulness to the Lord’s laws and commandments.

title: To Be Free of Heavy Burdens
preview: You must trust that the Savior has given His life so that you can make the required changes in your life—changes that will bring peace.

title: To Men of the Priesthood
preview: You men who hold this precious priesthood, bind it to your very souls. Be worthy of it at all times and in all circumstances.

title: Were There Not Ten Cleansed?
preview: If we’re ever going to show gratitude properly to our Heavenly Father, we should do it with all of our heart, might, mind, and strength.

title: What’s in It for Me?
preview: Taking up one’s cross and following the Savior means overcoming selfishness; it is a commitment to serve others.

title: With Holiness of Heart
preview: Every time we reach out with love, patience, kindness, generosity, we honor our covenants by saying, “Here am I; send me.”

title: Yielding to the Enticings of the Holy Spirit
preview: Stirrings within us originate from a divine source and, when followed, will help to keep us on course, thus protecting us from harmful influences and dangerous detours.

title: You Are All Heaven Sent
preview: Your role as sisters is special and unique in the Lord’s work. You are the nurturers and the caregivers.

title: A Child and a Disciple
preview: The Lord trusts His true disciples. He sends prepared people to His prepared servants.

title: A Prayer for the Children
preview: As parents we can hold life together … with love and faith, passed on to the next generation, one child at a time.

title: And That’s the Way It Is
preview: We need to achieve and maintain standards in order to participate in the important spiritual events of life.

title: Benediction
preview: I offer a plea that each of us will seek to live closer to the Lord and to commune with Him more frequently and with increased faith.

title: Blessed by Living Water
preview: Living water heals. It nourishes and sustains. It brings peace and joy.

title: Care for the Life of the Soul
preview: Truly converted disciples, though still imperfect, will pursue “the life of the soul” on any day, in any decade, amid any decadence and destruction.

title: Dear Are the Sheep That Have Wandered
preview: To those brokenhearted parents who have been righteous, diligent, and prayerful in the teaching of their disobedient children, we say to you, the Good Shepherd is watching over them.

title: Did I Tell You … ?
preview: In the eternal scheme of things, the most crucial and fulfilling thing you will do is to build a holy home and rear a strong family in love.

title: Eternal Marriage
preview: If you want something to last forever, you treat it differently. … It becomes special because you have made it so.

title: Faith through Tribulation Brings Peace and Joy
preview: However dark conditions may seem in this world today, whatever the storms we are facing personally, … joy can be ours now.

title: Follow the Instructions
preview: As you open your mind and heart to feel the Spirit, the Lord in His own time and in His own way will give you the instructions which will bless your life.

title: Forgiveness Will Change Bitterness to Love
preview: Forgiveness means that problems of the past no longer dictate our destinies, and we can focus on the future with God’s love in our hearts.

title: Give Thanks in All Things
preview: When we give thanks in all things, we see hardships and adversities in the context of the purpose of life.

title: Growing into the Priesthood
preview: Priesthood is the power and authority delegated to man by our Heavenly Father. The authority and majesty of it are beyond our comprehension.

title: Holy Place, Sacred Space
preview: Our ability to seek, recognize, and reverence the holy above the profane, and the sacred above the secular, defines our spirituality.

title: I Can Pray to Heavenly Father Anytime, Anywhere
preview: My young brothers and sisters, can you think of the last time you received an answer to your prayers? Was it when you lost something? Was it when you were scared? Maybe you were sick or someone you loved was sick. I have prayed in those times, too.

title: In Search of Treasure
preview: Learn from the past, prepare for the future, live in the present.

title: Loyalty
preview: Be loyal to the best that is in you. Be faithful and true to the covenants that are associated with the priesthood of God.

title: Overcoming the Stench of Sin
preview: Our loving Heavenly Father, … knowing that you and I would all sin and become unclean, provided a cleansing process from sin that … actually does work.

title: Preparing for Missionary Service
preview: How important it is for fathers and sons to work together on the basics in preparing for a mission.

title: Press Forward and Be Steadfast
preview: You can press forward with vision. The Holy Ghost will help you remain steadfast, and your testimony of the Savior will help you proceed with a perfect brightness of hope.

title: Seek, and Ye Shall Find
preview: As we engage our faith and commit our energy to draw closer to Jesus Christ, we begin to understand more fully who He really is.

title: Show You Know

Most importantly, we—your parents, leaders, and teachers—honor you, the children. We love you. We rejoice in who you are and who you can become.

title: Stand in Your Appointed Place
preview: May we reach out and rescue those who have fallen by the wayside, that not one precious soul will be lost.

title: Steadfast in Our Covenants
preview: To be steadfast in Christ implies keeping covenants. … When we do these things, … our spirits are lifted and our hearts are filled with love.

title: Sweet Power of Prayer
preview: We should pray in accord with the will of our Heavenly Father. He wants to test us, to strengthen us, and to help us achieve our full potential.

title: The Condition of the Church

Sometimes I would sleepwalk through my house and wake up suddenly in a strange place.

title: My Soul Delighteth in the Scriptures
preview: If you have not already developed the habit of daily scripture study, start now and keep studying.

title: Preparation for the Second Coming
