preview: Pray for the strength to walk the high road, which at times may be lonely but which will lead to peace and happiness and joy supernal.

preview: Let us have the courage to defy the consensus, the courage to stand for principle. Courage, not compromise, brings the smile of God’s approval.

title: The Dawning of a Brighter Day

preview: As conversion matures and is sustained through the workings of the Holy Ghost, peace and healing come to the soul.

preview: I would hope that we might go to the house of the Lord a little more frequently.

title: “Feed My Sheep”

title: Finding Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ

title: How Has Relief Society Blessed Your Life?

preview: I invite you to … do whatever it takes to earnestly seek truth, to know God the Eternal Father and His Son, Jesus Christ.

title: If Ye Are Prepared Ye Shall Not Fear

title: In the Strength of the Lord

preview: The most important thing we can do in this life is to keep the promises or covenants we have made with the Lord.

title: More Holiness Give Me
preview: It is important for families and individuals to aggressively seek more of the virtues which go beyond this mortal life.

title: Peace of Conscience and Peace of Mind

title: Perilous Times
preview: How grateful I am, in these perilous times, for the protection and guidance given to us by the sacred assurance that Jesus Christ lives today.

title: Press On
preview: There is one thing the Lord expects of us no matter our difficulties and sorrows: He expects us to press on.

preview: The Book of Mormon can and does change lives.

preview: Frequently reading, pondering, and applying the lessons of the scriptures, combined with prayer, become an irreplaceable part of gaining and sustaining a strong, vibrant testimony.

preview: Let no one underestimate the power of faith in the ordinary Latter-day Saints.

title: The Opportunity to Testify
preview: With … tender feelings of gratitude for all who have influenced my life in past years, I commit myself to the future.

title: The Power of God’s Love
preview: Filled with His love, we can endure pain, quell fear, forgive freely, avoid contention, renew strength, and bless and help others.

title: The Women in Our Lives
preview: How thankful I am, how thankful we all must be, for the women in our lives.

title: Walking towards the Light of His Love
preview: Connections forged among covenant women in Relief Society can … enlighten, enliven, and enrich the journey of life.

preview: May we have added insights into and greater appreciation for the power of testimony, especially as it is borne by those [who are bowed in years].

preview: The gospel of Jesus Christ gives us the strength and the eternal perspective to face what is coming with good cheer.

title: Glad Tidings from Cumorah
preview: You and I can not only survive but prevail, as did Moroni, in our efforts to stand for truth in perilous times.

title: He Knows You by Name
preview: You may not have heard the Lord call you by name, but He knows each one of you and He knows your name.

title: Hearts Bound Together
preview: When you were baptized, your ancestors looked down on you with hope. … They rejoiced to see one of their descendants make a covenant to find them.

preview: Now is the time to prepare to meet God. Tomorrow may be too late.

preview: We need more hardworking, testimony-enriched missionaries in order to reach more of our Heavenly Father’s children.

title: Strengthen Thy Brethren
preview: You must do what our Savior and His prophets … have always taught: serve, strengthen the faith, and nurture those who need your love and blessing.

preview: On the solid foundation of the Prophet Joseph’s divine calling and the revelations of God, which came through him, we go forward.

title: The Power of Preach My Gospel
preview: I encourage you to find out how this extraordinary resource can help in your missionary efforts.

title: The Sacred Call of Service
preview: The performance of one’s duty brings a sense of happiness and peace.

preview: I testify that the tender mercies of the Lord are available to all of us and that the Redeemer of Israel is eager to bestow such gifts upon us.

title: The Virtue of Kindness
preview: Kindness is the essence of a celestial life. Kindness is how a Christlike person treats others.

title: The Worth of Souls
preview: When we see the effect one person can have … , it perhaps is no wonder that the Lord reminded us, “Remember the worth of souls.”

title: Tithing—a Commandment Even for the Destitute
preview: Genuine sacrifice has been a hallmark of the faithful from the beginning.

preview: God knows the needs of His children, and He often works through us, prompting us to help one another.

title: What Seek Ye?
preview: Honest seekers of truth are finding answers to their questions—they are finding the Lord through His restored Church.

title: Who’s on the Lord’s Side? Who?
preview: The Lord needs to know on whom He can rely.

preview: The restored gospel of Jesus Christ is a pattern for all. … It is the good news—the timeless doctrine and atoning powers of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Be Prepared … Be Ye Strong from Henceforth
preview: Tragedies never triumph where personal righteousness prevails.

title: Becoming a Missionary
preview: You and I, today and always, are to bear witness of Jesus Christ and declare the message of the Restoration. … Missionary work is a manifestation of our spiritual identity and heritage.

title: Called and Chosen
preview: Those called, sustained, and set apart are entitled to our sustaining support.

preview: Prophets and apostles through the ages are our compass from the Lord. His direction through them is plain.

title: Do Your Duty—That Is Best

title: “Feed My Sheep”
preview: People are most receptive to our influence when they feel that we truly love them, and not only because we have a calling to fulfill.

title: Forgiveness
preview: Somehow forgiveness, with love and tolerance, accomplishes miracles that can happen in no other way.

preview: By keeping the covenants of the gospel, all of the momentary trials of life can be transcended.

preview: Your influence for good is incalculable and indescribable.

preview: We are faced with a choice. We can trust in our own strength, or we can journey to higher ground and come unto Christ.

preview: Following the Lord’s pattern to hear and give heed to divine truth will help you build a personal spiritual foundation and determine what you will become.

preview: There is absolutely nothing more important we can do for our families than to strengthen them in the scriptures.

preview: Decide now to make general conference a priority in your life. Decide to listen carefully and follow the teachings that are given.

preview: The Father’s plan of salvation and happiness … will help you overcome every challenge in life.

preview: Again and again the Book of Mormon teaches that the gospel of Jesus Christ is universal in its promise and effect.

title: An Outpouring of Blessings

title: A Call to the Rising Generation

title: The Love of God

title: A Word at Closing

title: Turn to the Lord

title: Watching with All Perseverance
preview: A spiritual early warning system … can help parents in Zion to be watchful and discerning concerning their children.

title: “You Are My Hands”

preview: Missionary service is a priesthood duty—an obligation the Lord expects of us who have been given so very much.

preview: Nowhere are the generosity and the kindness and mercy of God more manifest than in repentance.

preview: Our Savior is the Prince of Peace, the Great Healer, the only One who can truly cleanse us from the sting of sin.

preview: Studying the history of Relief Society gives definition and expression to who we are as disciples and followers of our Savior, Jesus Christ.

title: Faith—the Choice Is Yours

title: Gospel Learning and Teaching

title: He Teaches Us to Put Off the Natural Man
preview: I bear witness of the reality and power of the Savior’s Atonement to cleanse, purify, and make us and our homes holy.

preview: In our increasingly unrighteous world, it is essential that values based on religious belief be part of the public discourse.

title: Never Leave Him
preview: As you choose not to be offended or ashamed, you will feel His love and approval. You will know that you are becoming more like Him.

title: O That Cunning Plan of the Evil One
preview: There is hope for the addicted, and this hope comes through the Atonement of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Obedience to the Prophets
preview: What a great blessing it is to have prophets in our day!

title: Of Things That Matter Most
preview: If life and its rushed pace and many stresses have made it difficult for you to feel like rejoicing, then perhaps now is a good time to refocus on what matters most.

title: Our Very Survival
preview: May we have the wisdom to trust in and follow the counsel of the living prophets and apostles.

title: Pride and the Priesthood
preview: Pride is a switch that turns off priesthood power. Humility is a switch that turns it on.

title: Receive the Holy Ghost

title: Reflections on a Consecrated Life
preview: True success in this life comes in consecrating our lives—that is, our time and choices—to God’s purposes.

title: Rest unto Your Souls
preview: To find rest unto our souls includes peace of mind and heart, which is the result of learning and following the doctrine of Christ.

title: Serve with the Spirit
preview: Let us do whatever is required to qualify for the Holy Ghost as our companion.

preview: As we hold on to our children and follow the Savior’s lead, we will all return to our heavenly home and be safe in our Heavenly Father’s arms.

title: Steadfast and Immovable
preview: If we are faithful and endure to the end, we will receive all of Heavenly Father’s blessings, even eternal life and exaltation.

title: Temple Mirrors of Eternity: A Testimony of Family
preview: An eternal perspective of gospel conversion and temple covenants can help us see rich blessings in each generation of our forever families.

title: The Divine Gift of Gratitude
preview: A grateful heart … comes through expressing gratitude to our Heavenly Father for His blessings and to those around us for all that they bring into our lives.

title: The Holy Ghost and Revelation
preview: The Holy Ghost is the third member of the Godhead, and with the Father and the Son, He knows all things.

title: The Priesthood of Aaron
preview: The priesthood you bear is a special gift, for the giver is the Lord Himself. Use it, magnify it, and live worthy of it.

title: The Three Rs of Choice
preview: Each of us has come to this earth with all the tools necessary to make correct choices.

title: The Transforming Power of Faith and Character
preview: A consistent, righteous life produces an inner power and strength that can be permanently resistant to the eroding influence of sin and transgression.

title: Till We Meet Again
preview: Endure to the end we must, for our goal is eternal life in the presence of our Father in Heaven.

title: Trust in God, Then Go and Do
preview: You show your trust in Him when you listen with the intent to learn and repent and then you go and do whatever He asks.

title: Two Lines of Communication
preview: We must use both the personal line and the priesthood line in proper balance to achieve the growth that is the purpose of mortal life.

title: What Have You Done with My Name?
preview: Someday each one of us will have to account to our Savior, Jesus Christ, for what we have done with His name.

title: A Living Testimony
preview: Testimony requires the nurturing by the prayer of faith, the hungering for the word of God in the scriptures, and the obedience to the truth.

title: An Ensign to the Nations
preview: If we teach by the Spirit and you listen by the Spirit, some one of us will touch on your circumstance.

title: “As Many as I Love, I Rebuke and Chasten”
preview: The very experience of enduring chastening can refine us and prepare us for greater spiritual privileges.

title: At Parting
preview: None of us can conceive the full import of what Christ did for us in Gethsemane, but I am grateful every day of my life for His atoning sacrifice.

title: Become as a Little Child
preview: If we have a heart to learn and a willingness to follow the example of children, their divine attributes can hold a key to unlocking our own spiritual growth.

title: Called to Be Saints
preview: How blessed we are to have been brought into this fellowship of the Latter-day Saints!

title: Desire
preview: To achieve our eternal destiny, we will desire and work for the qualities required to become an eternal being.

title: Establishing a Christ-Centered Home
preview: We understand and believe in the eternal nature of the family. This understanding and belief should inspire us to do everything in our power to establish a Christ-centered home.

title: Face the Future with Faith
preview: Truth, covenants, and ordinances enable us to overcome fear and face the future with faith!

title: Finding Joy through Loving Service
preview: May we show our love and appreciation for the Savior’s atoning sacrifice through our simple, compassionate acts of service.

title: Followers of Christ
preview: Followers of Christ pattern their lives after the Savior to walk in the light.

title: Guardians of Virtue
preview: Prepare now so that you may qualify to receive all the blessings that await you in the Lord’s holy temples.

title: Guided by the Holy Spirit

title: Hope
preview: Our hope in the Atonement empowers us with eternal perspective.

title: I Believe in Being Honest and True
preview: Being true to our beliefs—even when doing so isn’t popular, easy, or fun—keeps us safely on the path that leads to eternal life with our Heavenly Father.

title: It’s Conference Once Again
preview: Thank you for your faith and devotion to the gospel, for the love and care you show to one another, and for the service you provide.

title: LDS Women Are Incredible!
preview: Much of what we accomplish in the Church is due to the selfless service of women.

title: Learning in the Priesthood
preview: If you will be diligent and obedient in the priesthood, treasures of spiritual knowledge will be poured out upon you.

title: More Than Conquerors through Him That Loved Us
preview: Trials are not just to test us. They are vitally important to the process of putting on the divine nature.

title: Opportunities to Do Good

title: Preparing the World for the Second Coming

title: Priesthood Power
preview: May we be worthy recipients of the divine power of the priesthood we bear. May it bless our lives and may we use it to bless the lives of others.

title: “Remember This: Kindness Begins with Me”
preview: Benevolence can bring joy and unity to your home, your class, your ward, and your school.

title: Sacred Keys of the Aaronic Priesthood
preview: The Lord wants every Aaronic Priesthood holder to invite all to come unto Christ—beginning with his own family.

title: Testimony

title: The Atonement Covers All Pain
preview: Our great personal challenge in mortality is to become “a saint through the atonement of Christ.”

title: The Essence of Discipleship
preview: When love becomes the guiding principle in our care for others, our service to them becomes the gospel in action.

title: The Eternal Blessings of Marriage
preview: The temple sealing has greater meaning as life unfolds. It will help you draw ever closer together and find greater joy and fulfillment.

title: The Holy Temple—a Beacon to the World
preview: The all-important and crowning blessings of membership in the Church are those blessings which we receive in the temples of God.

title: The Lord’s Richest Blessings
preview: As we pay our tithing faithfully, the Lord will open the windows of heaven and pour out upon us His richest blessings.

title: The Miracle of the Atonement
preview: There is no sin or transgression, pain or sorrow, which is outside of the healing power of His Atonement.

title: The Sabbath and the Sacrament
preview: Let your family be filled with love as you honor the Sabbath all day long and experience its spiritual blessings throughout the week.

title: The Sanctifying Work of Welfare
preview: The work of caring for one another and being “kind to the poor” is a sanctifying work, commanded of the Father.

title: The Spirit of Revelation
preview: The spirit of revelation is real—and can and does function in our individual lives and in the Church.

title: Waiting on the Road to Damascus
preview: Those who diligently seek to learn of Christ eventually will come to know Him.

title: What Manner of Men and Women Ought Ye to Be?
preview: May your efforts to develop Christlike attributes be successful so that His image may be engraven in your countenance and His attributes manifest in your behavior.

title: Your Potential, Your Privilege
preview: As you read the scriptures and listen to the words of the prophets with all your heart and mind, the Lord will tell you how to live up to your priesthood privileges.

title: A Time to Prepare

title: A Witness
preview: The Book of Mormon is the best guide to learn how well we are doing and how to do better.

title: As We Meet Again
preview: It is my prayer that we may be filled with the Spirit of the Lord as we listen to the messages today and tomorrow and learn those things the Lord would have us know.

title: Charity Never Faileth
preview: Plead for a desire to be filled with the gift of charity, the pure love of Christ.

title: Children
preview: I testify of the great blessing of children and of the happiness they will bring us in this life and in the eternities.

title: Choose Eternal Life
preview: Your eternal destiny will not be the result of chance but of choice. It is never too late to begin to choose eternal life!

title: Cleave unto the Covenants
preview: As we have faith in Christ and cleave unto our covenants, we will receive the joy spoken of in the holy scriptures and promised by our latter-day prophets.

title: Counsel to Youth
preview: Despite the opposition, trials, and temptations, you need not fail or fear.

title: Covenants
preview: When we realize that we are children of the covenant, we know who we are and what God expects of us.

title: Dare to Stand Alone
preview: May we ever be courageous and prepared to stand for what we believe.

title: Doing the Right Thing at the Right Time, without Delay
preview: The Savior … gave us a great example about not waiting to administer relief to those who have lost a sense of happiness and joy.

title: Forget Me Not
preview: It is my prayer and blessing that you will never forget that you are truly precious daughters in God’s kingdom.

title: It Is Better to Look Up
preview: If we, like President Monson, exercise our faith and look to God for help, we will not be overwhelmed with the burdens of life.

title: Love Her Mother
preview: How can a father raise a happy, well-adjusted daughter in today’s increasingly toxic world? The answer has been taught by the Lord’s prophets.

title: Missionaries Are a Treasure of the Church
preview: I am thankful that missionaries are called by the Lord, that they respond to that call, and that they are serving throughout the world.

title: Perfect Love Casteth Out Fear
preview: If you will respond to the invitation to share your beliefs and feelings about the restored gospel of Jesus Christ, a spirit of love and a spirit of courage will be your constant companion.

title: Personal Revelation and Testimony
preview: If we diligently keep the commandments and ask in faith, answers will come in the Lord’s own way and in His time.

title: Preparation in the Priesthood: “I Need Your Help”
preview: Don’t worry about how inexperienced you are or think you are, but think about what, with the Lord’s help, you can become.

title: Providing in the Lord’s Way
preview: The welfare principles of the Church are not simply good ideas; they are revealed truths from God—they are His way of helping the needy.

title: Redemption
preview: Through Christ, people can and do change their lives and obtain redemption.

title: Stand in Holy Places
preview: Communication with our Father in Heaven—including our prayers to Him and His inspiration to us—is necessary in order for us to weather the storms and trials of life.

title: Teaching after the Manner of the Spirit
preview: While we are all teachers, we must fully realize that it is the Holy Ghost who is the real teacher and witness of all truth.

title: Teachings of Jesus
preview: Jesus Christ is the Only Begotten and Beloved Son of God. … He is our Savior from sin and death. This is the most important knowledge on earth.

title: The Book of Mormon—a Book from God
preview: Together with the Bible, the Book of Mormon is an indispensable witness of the doctrines of Christ and His divinity.

title: The Divine Gift of Repentance
preview: Only through repentance do we gain access to the atoning grace of Jesus Christ.

title: The Hearts of the Children Shall Turn
preview: I invite the young people of the Church to learn about and experience the Spirit of Elijah.

title: The Importance of a Name
preview: Let us develop the habit … of making it clear that The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is the name by which the Lord Himself has directed that we be known.

title: The Opportunity of a Lifetime
preview: Through your devoted service and willing sacrifice, your mission will become holy ground to you.

title: The Power of Scripture
preview: Scriptures are like packets of light that illuminate our minds and give place to guidance and inspiration from on high.

title: The Power of the Aaronic Priesthood
preview: You and the Aaronic Priesthood office you hold are essential to Heavenly Father’s work with His children and the preparation of this earth for the Second Coming.

title: The Privilege of Prayer
preview: Prayer is one of the most precious gifts of God to man.

title: The Songs They Could Not Sing
preview: While we do not know all the answers, we do know important principles that allow us to face tragedies with faith and confidence.

title: The Time Shall Come
preview: With you, I stand in awe as this work moves forward miraculously, marvelously, and irresistibly.

title: Until We Meet Again
preview: May the spirit we have felt here be and abide with us as we go about those things which occupy us each day.

title: Waiting upon the Lord: Thy Will Be Done
preview: The purpose of our life on earth is to grow, develop, and be strengthened through our own experiences.

title: We Are All Enlisted
preview: From every man, young and old, who bears the priesthood, I ask for a stronger and more devoted voice, … a voice for good, a voice for the gospel, a voice for God.

title: What I Hope My Granddaughters (and Grandsons) Will Understand about Relief Society
preview: From the day the gospel began to be restored in this dispensation, the Lord has needed faithful women to participate as His disciples.

title: You Matter to Him
preview: The Lord uses a scale very different from the world’s to weigh the worth of a soul.

title: Aaronic Priesthood: Arise and Use the Power of God
preview: The priesthood needs to be exercised to accomplish any good. You are called to “arise and shine forth,” not to hide your light in darkness.

title: Abide in the Lord’s Territory!
preview: Our daily question must be, “Do my actions place me in the Lord’s or in the enemy’s territory?”

title: And a Little Child Shall Lead Them
preview: Husbands and wives should understand that their first calling—from which they will never be released—is to one another and then to their children.

title: Arise and Shine Forth
preview: One of the greatest ways we can arise and shine forth is to confidently obey the commandments of God.

title: As We Close This Conference
preview: May you ponder the truths you have heard, and may they help you to become even better than you were when conference began.

title: As We Gather Once Again
preview: Our Heavenly Father is mindful of each of us and our needs. May we be filled with His Spirit as we partake of the proceedings of this conference.

title: Believe, Obey, and Endure
preview: Believe that remaining strong and faithful to the truths of the gospel is of utmost importance. I testify that it is!

title: Coming to Ourselves: The Sacrament, the Temple, and Sacrifice in Service
preview: We become converted and spiritually self-reliant as we prayerfully live our covenants.

title: Converted to His Gospel through His Church
preview: The purpose of the Church is to help us live the gospel.

title: Faith, Fortitude, Fulfillment: A Message to Single Parents
preview: You are striving to raise your children in righteousness and truth, knowing that while you cannot change the past, you can shape the future.

title: Families under Covenant
preview: There is nothing that has come or will come into your family as important as the sealing blessings.

title: Having the Vision to Do
preview: If we are to prosper rather than perish, we must gain a vision of ourselves as the Savior sees us.

title: He Truly Loves Us
preview: Because of the heaven-designed pattern of the family, we more fully understand how our Heavenly Father truly loves each of us equally and fully.

title: How to Obtain Revelation and Inspiration for Your Personal Life
preview: Why does the Lord want us to pray to Him and to ask? Because that is how revelation is received.

title: In Tune with the Music of Faith
preview: God loves all His children. He wants all of them to return to Him. He desires everyone to be in tune with the sacred music of faith.

title: Mountains to Climb
preview: If we have faith in Jesus Christ, the hardest as well as the easiest times in life can be a blessing.

title: Now Is the Time to Arise and Shine!
preview: As daughters of God, you were born to lead.

title: Only upon the Principles of Righteousness
preview: Wise parents prepare their children to get along without them. They provide opportunities for growth as children acquire the spiritual maturity to exercise their agency properly.

title: Sacrifice
preview: Our lives of service and sacrifice are the most appropriate expressions of our commitment to serve the Master and our fellowmen.

title: Seek Learning: You Have a Work to Do
preview: Bless your children and your future home by learning as much as you can now.

title: Special Lessons
preview: It is my hope and prayer that we will continue to bear nobly our burdens and to reach out to those among us who are suffering.

title: Teaching Our Children to Understand
preview: Teaching our children to understand is more than just imparting information. It’s helping our children get the doctrine into their hearts.

title: Thanks Be to God
preview: How much better it would be if all could be more aware of God’s providence and love and express that gratitude to Him.

title: That the Lost May Be Found
preview: As you seek to live the gospel and doctrine of Christ, the Holy Ghost will guide you and your family.

title: The Doctrine of Christ
preview: In the Church today, just as anciently, establishing the doctrine of Christ or correcting doctrinal deviations is a matter of divine revelation.

title: The Laborers in the Vineyard
preview: Please listen to the prompting of the Holy Spirit telling you right now, this very moment, that you should accept the atoning gift of the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: The Merciful Obtain Mercy
preview: When our hearts are filled with the love of God, we become “kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving.”

title: The Power of Deliverance
preview: We can be delivered from the ways of evil and wickedness by turning to the teachings of the holy scriptures.

title: The Powers of Heaven
preview: Priesthood holders young and old need both authority and power—the necessary permission and the spiritual capacity to represent God in the work of salvation.

title: The Race of Life
preview: Where did we come from? Why are we here? Where do we go after this life? No longer need these universal questions remain unanswered.

title: The Rescue for Real Growth
preview: Saving souls is the work the Savior has called all of us to do.

title: The Vision of Prophets regarding Relief Society: Faith, Family, Relief
preview: Faith, family, and relief—these three simple words have come to express the vision of prophets for sisters in the Church.

title: The Why of Priesthood Service
preview: Understanding the why of the gospel and the why of the priesthood will help us to see the divine purpose of all of this.

title: To Hold Sacred
preview: Sacred things are to be treated with more care, given greater deference, and regarded with deeper reverence.

title: Was It Worth It?
preview: The work of naturally and normally sharing the gospel with those we care about and love will be the work and joy of our lives.

title: What Thinks Christ of Me?
preview: As you love Him, trust Him, believe Him, and follow Him, you will feel His love and approval.

title: Willing and Worthy to Serve
preview: Miracles are everywhere to be found when the priesthood is understood, its power is honored and used properly, and faith is exerted.

title: An Unspeakable Gift from God
preview: The Holy Ghost works in perfect unity with Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ, fulfilling many important roles and distinct responsibilities.

title: Ask the Missionaries! They Can Help You!
preview: All missionaries, younger and older, serve with the sole hope of making life better for other people.

title: Be Anxiously Engaged
preview: Great things are brought about and burdens are lightened through the efforts of many hands “anxiously engaged in a good cause.”

title: Be Valiant in Courage, Strength, and Activity
preview: Qualify yourselves as did the 2,000 stripling soldiers by being valiant in courage as worthy priesthood holders.

title: “Because I Live, Ye Shall Live Also”
preview: Because of Him, even our Savior, Jesus Christ, those feelings of sorrow, loneliness, and despair will one day be swallowed up in a fulness of joy.

title: Becoming a True Disciple
preview: As we obey His commandments and serve our fellowmen, we become better disciples of Jesus Christ.

title: Becoming Goodly Parents
preview: There are many ways that goodly parents can access the help and support they need to teach the gospel of Jesus Christ to their children.

title: Being a More Christian Christian
preview: This is the call of Christ to every Christian today: “Feed my lambs. … Feed my sheep.”

title: Beware Concerning Yourselves
preview: Stay on the priesthood path by deepening your conversion and strengthening your family. … Avoid tragedy by heeding spiritual “Beware” signs placed along our way by God and prophets.

title: Blessings of the Sacrament
preview: We will be blessed as we feel gratitude for the Atonement of Jesus Christ, renew our baptismal covenants, feel forgiveness, and receive inspiration from the Holy Ghost.

title: Brethren, We Have Work to Do
preview: As men of the priesthood, we have an essential role to play in society, at home, and in the Church.

title: By Faith All Things Are Fulfilled
preview: Faith will help us to safely climb the gospel path, overcome every challenge of mortality, and return to the majestic presence of our Heavenly Father.

title: Can Ye Feel So Now?
preview: Some in the Church believe they can’t answer Alma’s question with a resounding yes. They do not “feel so now.”

title: “Come unto Me, O Ye House of Israel”
preview: As we come unto our Savior, Jesus Christ, and purify our hearts, we will all be instruments in fulfilling the mighty promises of the Book of Mormon.

title: Consider the Blessings
preview: Our Heavenly Father is aware of our needs and will help us as we call upon Him for assistance.

title: Converted unto the Lord
preview: Knowing that the gospel is true is the essence of a testimony. Consistently being true to the gospel is the essence of conversion.

title: First Observe, Then Serve
preview: With practice, each of us can become more like the Savior as we serve God’s children.

title: God Be with You Till We Meet Again
preview: As we take the messages of the past two days into our hearts and into our lives, we will be blessed.

title: Help Them Aim High
preview: With your guidance, those you lead will be able to see, want, and believe they can achieve their full potential for service in God’s kingdom.

title: I Know It. I Live It. I Love It.
preview: We are followers of our Savior, Jesus Christ. Such conversion and confidence is the result of diligent and deliberate effort. It is individual. It is the process of a lifetime.

title: Is Faith in the Atonement of Jesus Christ Written in Our Hearts?
preview: Making, keeping, and rejoicing in our covenants will be the evidence that the Atonement of Jesus Christ is truly written in our hearts.

title: Learning with Our Hearts
preview: One way to come unto Christ is by seeking to learn essential truths with our hearts.

title: Of Regrets and Resolutions
preview: The more we devote ourselves to the pursuit of holiness and happiness, the less likely we will be on a path to regrets.

title: One Step Closer to the Savior
preview: Conversion is the goal of all gospel learning and teaching. Conversion is not a onetime event. It is a lifelong quest to become more like the Savior.

title: Protect the Children
preview: None should resist the plea that we unite to increase our concern for the welfare and future of our children—the rising generation.

title: See Others as They May Become
preview: We must develop the capacity to see men not as they are at present but as they may become.

title: Temple Standard
preview: The high standards of temple building employed by this Church are a type and even a symbol of how we should be living our own lives.

title: The Atonement
preview: Wherever our members and missionaries may go, our message is one of faith and hope in the Savior Jesus Christ.

title: The Caregiver
preview: You will be strengthened and yet inspired to know the limits and extent of your ability to serve.

title: The First Great Commandment
preview: We have a life of devoted discipleship to give in demonstrating our love of the Lord.

title: The Joy of Redeeming the Dead
preview: “He shall plant in the hearts of the children the promises made to the fathers, and the hearts of the children shall turn to their fathers.”

title: The Joy of the Priesthood
preview: Let us embrace and understand the wonder and privilege of the priesthood. Let us accept and love the responsibilities we are asked to fulfill.

title: The Lord Has Not Forgotten You
preview: Our Heavenly Father and our Savior, Jesus Christ, know us and love us. … We can feel of Their love and compassion in our suffering.

title: Trial of Your Faith
preview: Like the intense fire that transforms iron into steel, as we remain faithful during the fiery trial of faith, we are spiritually refined and strengthened.

title: Welcome to Conference
preview: May we listen attentively to the messages…, that we may feel the Spirit of the Lord and gain the knowledge He would desire for us.

title: What Shall a Man Give in Exchange for His Soul?
preview: We are to give up all our sins, big or small, for the Father’s reward of eternal life.

title: Where Is the Pavilion?
preview: The pavilion that seems to intercept divine aid does not cover God but occasionally covers us. God is never hidden, yet sometimes we are.

title: Wide Awake to Our Duties
preview: We must be awake to our duty and continue with faith as we draw upon the comforting, strengthening, enabling, and healing power of the Atonement.

title: A Sure Foundation
preview: Let us accept the Savior’s invitation to come unto Him. Let us build our lives upon a safe and a sure foundation.

title: Be Not Moved!
preview: Stand firm. Be steadfast. “Stand for truth and righteousness.” Stand as a witness. Be a standard to the world. Stand in holy places.

title: Beautiful Mornings
preview: We need not fear the future, nor falter in hope and good cheer, because God is with us.

title: Being Accepted of the Lord
preview: Seeking and receiving the acceptance of the Lord will lead to the knowledge that we are chosen and blessed by Him.

title: Catch the Wave
preview: I thank God and His Son, Jesus Christ, for the Restoration and its power to propel a magnificent wave of truth and righteousness across the earth.

title: Come, All Ye Sons of God
preview: May each one of us search the scriptures with diligence, plan his life with purpose, teach the truth with testimony, and serve the Lord with love.

title: “Come unto Me”
preview: By His words and His example, Christ has shown us how to draw closer to Him.

title: Followers of Christ
preview: Following Christ is not a casual or occasional practice but a continuous commitment and way of life that applies at all times and in all places.

title: For Peace at Home
preview: One of the greatest blessings we can offer to the world is the power of a Christ-centered home where the gospel is taught, covenants are kept, and love abounds.

title: Four Titles
preview: I would like to suggest four titles … that may help us recognize our individual roles in God’s eternal plan and our potential as priesthood holders.

title: It’s a Miracle
preview: If you’re not a full-time missionary with a missionary badge pinned on your coat, now is the time to paint one on your heart—painted, as Paul said, “not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God.”

title: “Lord, I Believe”
preview: Honestly acknowledge your questions and your concerns, but first and forever fan the flame of your faith, because all things are possible to them that believe.

title: Marriage: Watch and Learn
preview: The promises of the Lord are extended to all those who follow the pattern of life that builds happy, holy marriage relationships.

title: Obedience Brings Blessings
preview: A knowledge of truth and the answers to our greatest questions come to us as we are obedient to the commandments of God.

title: Obedience to Law Is Liberty
preview: Men and women receive their agency as a gift from God, but their liberty and, in turn, their eternal happiness come from obedience to His laws.

title: Personal Peace: The Reward of Righteousness
preview: Even with the trials of life, because of the Savior’s Atonement and His grace, righteous living will be rewarded with personal peace.

title: Redemption
preview: Inasmuch as we follow Christ, we seek to participate in and further His redemptive work.

title: Stand Strong in Holy Places
preview: Standing obedient and strong on the doctrine of our God, we stand in holy places, for His doctrine is sacred and will not change.

title: The Father and the Son
preview: At the heart of the gospel of Jesus Christ and its power to save is a correct understanding of the Father and the Son.

title: The Gospel to All the World
preview: The Church has moved steadily across the world from nation to nation, culture to culture, people to people, on the Lord’s calendar and in His time.

title: The Home: The School of Life
preview: Lessons are learned in a home—the place that can become a piece of heaven here on earth.

title: The Hope of God’s Light
preview: As we seek to increase our love for God and strive to love our neighbor, the light of the gospel will surround and uplift us.

title: The Lord’s Way
preview: The Lord’s way is that we hearken to our leaders’ teachings, understand correct principles, and govern ourselves.

title: The Power of the Priesthood in the Boy
preview: The priesthood in the boy is just as powerful as the priesthood in the man when exercised in righteousness.

title: The Savior Wants to Forgive
preview: The Lord loves us and wants us to understand His willingness to forgive.

title: The Words We Speak
preview: How we speak to our children and the words we use can encourage and uplift them and strengthen their faith.

title: These Things I Know
preview: Of all that I have read and taught and learned, the one most precious and sacred truth that I have to offer is my special witness of Jesus Christ.

title: “This Is My Work and Glory”
preview: God has freely given His power to those who accept and honor His priesthood, which leads to the promised blessings of immortality and eternal life.

title: Until We Meet Again
preview: I pray that the Lord will bless and keep you, my brothers and sisters. May His promised peace be with you now and always.

title: We Are Daughters of Our Heavenly Father
preview: As daughters of God we are each unique and different in our circumstances and experiences. And yet our part matters—because we matter.

title: We Are One
preview: I pray that wherever we are and whatever duties we have in the priesthood of God, we will be united in the cause to bring the gospel to all the world.

title: We Believe in Being Chaste
preview: Obedience to the law of chastity will increase our happiness in mortality and make possible our progress in eternity.

title: Welcome to Conference
preview: I urge you to be attentive and receptive to the messages which we will hear. That we may do so is my prayer.

title: When You Save a Girl, You Save Generations
preview: Your virtuous lives will bless your ancestors, your families now, and family members yet to come.

title: Your Holy Places
preview: Whether [your holy places] are geographic or moments in time, they are equally sacred and have incredible strengthening power.

title: Your Sacred Duty to Minister
preview: You received the power, the authority, and the sacred duty to minister the moment you were ordained to the priesthood.

title: Your Wonderful Journey Home
preview: As you joyfully use the map your loving Father has provided for your journey, it will lead you to holy places and you will rise to your supernal potential.

title: Be Meek and Lowly of Heart
preview: Being meek does not mean weakness, but it does mean behaving with goodness and kindness.

title: Be Ye Converted
preview: True conversion occurs as you continue to act upon the doctrines you know are true and keep the commandments, day after day, month after month.

title: Bind Up Their Wounds
preview: I pray that we may prepare ourselves to give whatever priesthood service the Lord may set before us on our mortal journey.

title: Called of Him to Declare His Word
preview: If you are humble and obedient and hearken to the voice of the Spirit, you will find great happiness in your service as a missionary.

title: Claim the Blessings of Your Covenants
preview: As we renew and honor our covenants, our burdens can be lightened and we can continually become purified and strengthened.

title: Come, Join with Us
preview: Regardless of your circumstances, your personal history, or the strength of your testimony, there is room for you in this Church.

title: Continually Holding Fast
preview: May we continually hold fast to the iron rod that leads to the presence of our Heavenly Father.

title: Decisions for Eternity
preview: The wise use of your freedom to make your own decisions is crucial to your spiritual growth, now and for eternity.

title: Do We Know What We Have?
preview: Priesthood ordinances and covenants provide access to the fulness of the blessings promised to us by God, which are made possible by the Savior’s Atonement.

title: Drawing Closer to God
preview: Our Savior wants us to really love Him to the point that we want to align our will with His.

title: General Conference: Strengthening Faith and Testimony
preview: Oh, how we need general conference! Through conferences our faith is fortified and our testimonies deepened.

title: Hastening the Lord’s Game Plan!
preview: We each must develop and carry out our own personal game plan to serve with enthusiasm alongside the full-time missionaries.

title: “I Will Not Fail Thee, nor Forsake Thee”
preview: Our Heavenly Father … knows that we learn and grow and become stronger as we face and survive the trials through which we must pass.

title: Lamentations of Jeremiah: Beware of Bondage
preview: Our challenge is to avoid bondage of any kind, help the Lord gather His elect, and sacrifice for the rising generation.

title: Like a Broken Vessel
preview: How do you best respond when mental or emotional challenges confront you or those you love?

title: Look Ahead and Believe
preview: In the sight of the Lord, it is not so much what we have done or where we have been but much more where we are willing to go.

title: Look Up
preview: Today is the time to look to the Source of truth and ensure that our testimonies are strong.

title: No Other Gods
preview: Are we serving priorities or gods ahead of the God we profess to worship?

title: Personal Strength through the Atonement of Jesus Christ
preview: Through the Atonement of Jesus Christ, each of us can become clean and the burden of our rebellion will be lifted.

title: Power in the Priesthood
preview: A man may open the drapes so the warm sunlight comes into the room, but the man does not own the sun or the light or the warmth it brings.

title: Put Your Trust in the Lord
preview: Become engaged in doing what you can in sharing the great message of the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: Small and Simple Things
preview: Let us reach out to others with faith and with love.

title: Teaching with the Power and Authority of God
preview: The Lord has provided the way for every worthy Latter-day Saint to teach in the Savior’s way.

title: The Doctrines and Principles Contained in the Articles of Faith
preview: Each article of faith adds unique value to our understanding of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

title: The Key to Spiritual Protection
preview: Peace can be settled in the heart of each who turns to the scriptures and unlocks the promises of protection and redemption.

title: The Moral Force of Women
preview: Your intuition is to do good and to be good, and as you follow the Holy Spirit, your moral authority and influence will grow.

title: The Power, Joy, and Love of Covenant Keeping
preview: I invite each of us to evaluate how much we love the Savior, using as a measure how joyfully we keep our covenants.

title: The Strength to Endure
preview: Our ability to endure to the end in righteousness will be in direct proportion to the strength of our testimony and the depth of our conversion.

title: The Windows of Heaven
preview: Spiritual and temporal blessings come into our lives as we live the law of tithing.

title: Till We Meet Again
preview: May we show increased kindness toward one another, and may we ever be found doing the work of the Lord.

title: To My Grandchildren
preview: There is one overarching commandment that will help us to meet the challenges and lead to the heart of a happy family life.

title: True Shepherds
preview: Home teaching answers many prayers and permits us to see the transformations which can take place in people’s lives.

title: We Have Great Reason to Rejoice
preview: When you love, watch over, and serve others in small and simple ways, you are actively participating in the work of salvation.

title: We Never Walk Alone
preview: You will one day stand aside and look at your difficult times, and you will realize that He was always there beside you.

title: Welcome to Conference
preview: It is my prayer that we may be filled with the Spirit of the Lord as we listen and learn.

title: Wilt Thou Be Made Whole?
preview: As we repent and become converted to the Lord, we become whole, and our guilt is swept away.

title: Ye Are No More Strangers
preview: In this Church there are no strangers and no outcasts. There are only brothers and sisters.

title: You Can Do It Now!
preview: As long as we are willing to rise up again and continue on the path, … we can learn something from failure and become better and happier.

title: A Priceless Heritage of Hope
preview: Henry B. Eyring encourages us to leave an inheritance of hope for those who will follow our example.

title: Are You Sleeping through the Restoration?
preview: Dieter F. Uchtdorf cautions that selfishness, addictions, and competing priorities can keep us from giving our best effort as disciples of Christ.

title: Be Strong and of a Good Courage
preview: Thomas S. Monson counsels priesthood holders to have moral courage in these challenging times and to be willing to defend their beliefs.

title: Bear Up Their Burdens with Ease
preview: David A. Bednar teaches that our challenges help us learn to rely on the Savior’s Atonement.

title: Christ the Redeemer
preview: Carlos H. Amado testifies that all who have lived or will live on earth are blessed by the Atonement of Jesus Christ.

title: Daughters in the Covenant
preview: Henry B. Eyring encourages women to keep their covenants, including those made at baptism, as they progress along the path back to Heavenly Father.

title: “Fear Not; I Am with Thee”
preview: Jean A. Stevens teaches how greater faith and trust in the Lord can help us find peace and overcome challenges.

title: Following Up
preview: M. Russell Ballard encourages Latter-day Saints to be faithful missionaries and to follow up on their missionary efforts.

title: Grateful in Any Circumstances
preview: Dieter F. Uchtdorf teaches that we can choose to be grateful in any circumstances, including in the midst of tribulation.

title: “I Have Given You an Example”
preview: Richard G. Scott explains how we can follow the Savior’s example and be a loving influence for good in the lives of others.

title: If Ye Lack Wisdom
preview: Marcos A. Aidukaitis gives guidance for recognizing truth—observing its fruits, experimenting on the word of God, and seeking personal revelation.

title: “If Ye Love Me, Keep My Commandments”
preview: Robert D. Hales teaches of the blessings that come when we use our agency to obey God’s commandments, as the Savior Jesus Christ did.

title: Keeping Covenants Protects Us, Prepares Us, and Empowers Us
preview: Rosemary M. Wixom encourages girls and women of all ages to make and keep sacred covenants in order to return to Heavenly Father’s presence.

title: Let Your Faith Show
preview: Russell M. Nelson counsels us to increase our faith by living our religion. He encourages us not to hide our faith but to let it show.

title: Let’s Not Take the Wrong Way
preview: Claudio D. Zivic counsels us to stay on the gospel path by keeping the commandments and to repent when we need to get back on the right path.

title: Live True to the Faith
preview: William R. Walker encourages Latter-day Saints to live true to the faith, honoring the legacy of their faithful ancestors.

title: Love—the Essence of the Gospel
preview: Thomas S. Monson teaches how small acts of love, kindness, and forgiveness can make a big difference in others’ lives.

title: Obedience through Our Faithfulness
preview: L. Tom Perry teaches that obedience is a choice to trust in God’s unlimited wisdom and power rather than our own limited knowledge and power.
